programme.title: Hora dos Portugueses
programme.desc: Magazine diário, com diferentes olhares, junto de comunidades de portugueses espalhados pelo mundo, para retratar as atuais formas de viver a portugalidade nos diferentes territórios e reconhecer os feitos e conquistas dos portugueses que compõem estes grupos de cidadãos.

programme.title: Música na Praça
programme.desc: Seleção dos melhores momentos musicais da Praça da Alegria.

programme.title: Jornal da Tarde
programme.desc: Todos os dias, às 13 horas, a sua hora de almoço é completada com a atualização das notícias que marcam a atualidade nacional e mundial, desde a política, a economia, a sociedade e sem esquecer o desporto.

programme.title: Ouvir Quem Vê Num Minuto
programme.desc: "Ouvir Quem Vê Num Minuto" é um programa da responsabilidade de Clara Almeida Santos, Provedora do Telespectador da RTP dedicado a dar voz ao público e a reforçar a transparência do serviço público de televisão.

programme.title: Estrelas ao Sábado
programme.desc: Em Estrelas ao Sábado vão brilhar o talento e as raízes da nossa música. Isabel Silva é a anfitriã deste formato inovador, que vai dar voz a todos aqueles que queiram mostrar o seu talento, interpretando os mais diversos géneros da música popular portuguesa, mas só um será o vencedor.

programme.title: O Preço Certo
programme.desc: Há mais de duas décadas em emissão contínua na RTP1, "O Preço Certo", é o gameshow de maior longevidade da televisão mundial. Estreado pela primeira vez em 1956 nos Estados Unidos, já foi transmitido em mais de 30 países.

programme.title: Telejornal
programme.desc: A mais rigorosa seleção de notícias, todos os dias às 20h00. De segunda a domingo, João Adelino Faria, José Rodrigues dos Santos, Cristina Esteves e Ana Lourenço mostram-lhe o que de mais relevante se passou o país e no mundo.

programme.title: The Floor
programme.desc: Com apresentação de Vasco Palmeirim, The Floor vai desafiar 100 concorrentes a competir em incríveis duelos de perguntas de conhecimento e cultural geral. Cada concorrente tem uma casa de jogo com uma categoria.

programme.title: Espero Por Ti no Politeama
programme.desc: Espero Por Ti no Politeama, a Revista-Cabaret de Filipe La Féria, é uma sátira ao Portugal de hoje e uma celebração da Vida, da Esperança e do Otimismo.

programme.title: Misteriosa Obsessão
programme.desc: Telly Paretta é uma mulher que luta por superar a perda do seu filho de oito anos. Um dia, seu psicoterapeuta diz-lhe que o seu filho não é mais que um produto da sua imaginação.

programme.title: Dragão Vermelho
programme.desc: Um assassino como o Dr. Hannibal Lecter arranja sempre admiradores; criaturas pervertidas que regozijam com os detalhes dos seus crimes brutais.

programme.title: Coração de Dragão
programme.desc: No séc. X, um homem associa-se ao último dragão para lembrar às pessoas a existência de um antigo código de honra e inspirá-las a lutar pela liberdade contra um rei tirano.

programme.title: Fúria
programme.desc: Abril de 1945.

programme.title: Fúria
programme.desc: Abril de 1945.

programme.title: Os Bad Boys
programme.desc: Um lote de heroína avaliada em cerca de 100 milhões de dólares é roubado do próprio depósito da polícia. O caso será encarregue aos agentes Burnett e Lowery, uma dupla muito peculiar pelos métodos que utilizam.

programme.title: O Último Vermeer
programme.desc: Enquanto Joseph Piller (Claes Bang), um judeu holandês, lutava na Resistência durante a Segunda Guerra Mundial, o espirituoso e afável conhecedor de arte Han van Meegeren (Guy Pearce) era anfitrião de saraus hedonistas e vendia tesouros de arte ho...

programme.title: A Troca
programme.desc: Los Angeles, 1928. Christine Collins é uma mãe solteira cujo filho desaparece sem deixar rasto. Meses depois, a polícia comunica-lhe que encontrou a criança mas, assim que o vê, Christine sabe que não é o filho dela.

programme.title: Um homem furioso
programme.desc: H é um homem frio e misterioso, que trabalha para uma companhia responsável por transportar milhões de dólares todas as semanas em Los Angeles. Mas quando ele e o colega são alvos de uma tentativa de roubo, a sua verdadeira motivação é revelada...

programme.title: Boyhood: Momentos De Uma Vida
programme.desc: Após o divórcio, uma mãe e um pai continuam a tarefa partilhada de educar o seu filho mais novo através da adolescência e, finalmente, até à idade adulta.

programme.title: Na Linha de Fogo
programme.desc: Um agente veterano dos serviços secretos trabalha como guarda-costas do presidente dos Estados Unidos.

programme.title: Cães Danados
programme.desc: Joe Cabot (Lawrence Tierney), um experiente criminoso, reuniu seis bandidos para um grande roubo de diamantes, mas estes seis homens não sabem nada um sobre os outros e cada um utiliza uma cor como codinome.

programme.title: Passageiros
programme.desc: Uma nave espacial transporta milhares de pessoas para um planeta colónia, que tem uma avaria em uma de suas câmaras de sono.

programme.title: Em Defesa de Sua Majestade
programme.desc: Quando o pai de Chon é assassinado por um rebelde chinês que foge para Inglaterra, Chon e Roy decidem partir para Londres em busca de vingança.

programme.title: Bad Boys II
programme.desc: Dois polícias do departamento de narcóticos investigam a invasão de Extasy na Flórida.

programme.title: Triplo 9
programme.desc: Um gangue de criminosos e polícias corruptos planeiam a morte de um polícia, com o objetivo de realizarem o seu maior golpe de sempre.

programme.title: Inferno
programme.desc: O famoso simbologista Robert Langdon encontra um trilho de pistas que conduzem ao próprio Dante. Quando Langdon acorda, com amnésia, num hospital italiano alia-se a Sienna Brooks, uma médica que o ajudará a recuperar as suas memórias.

programme.title: Psico III
programme.desc: Logo agora que pensávamos que era seguro voltar a entrar no duche! O terror regressa quando uma freira foragida (Diana Scarwid) com as mesmas iniciais de Marion Crane procura abriga no Motel Bates, espoletando o instinto assassino de Norman.

programme.title: Para Além do Horizonte
programme.desc: Chirs e Annie não conseguiram superar a morte dos seus dois filhos ocorrida num acidente de viação. Quatro anos depois Chris também morre e descobre que o Céu existe e que é um grande lugar.

programme.title: Coração de Dragão
programme.desc: No séc. X, um homem associa-se ao último dragão para lembrar às pessoas a existência de um antigo código de honra e inspirá-las a lutar pela liberdade contra um rei tirano.

programme.title: Oficina do Diabo
programme.desc: Neste thriller sinistro, um ator pede a uma demonóloga para ajudá-lo a conseguir um papel, e o seu fim de semana juntos irrompe em violência ritual.

programme.title: A Rapariga Dinamarquesa
programme.desc: Neste drama inspirado na história da pioneira transexual Lili Elbe, um casal de artistas na Dinamarca dos anos 20 embarca numa viagem de amor incondicional.

programme.title: Acordado
programme.desc: Clay Beresford, é um jovem milionário que aparenta ter tudo - dinheiro, uma lindíssima mulher e uma carreira lucrativa - mas, o que mais precisa é de fazer o transplante de coração que poderá salvar-lhe a vida.

programme.title: O Massacre
programme.desc: Na sequência da morte do seu filho o chefe da polícia secreta de Chicago contrata um ex-agente para desmantelar a Mafia que opera naquela cidade.

programme.title: Dead Man Down Um Homem A Abater
programme.desc: Victor é o braço direito de Alphonse, o líder de uma organização criminosa que está a ser perseguido por alguém que vai matando os membros do seu gangue e lhe envia notas ameaçadoras.

programme.title: A Ilha das Cabeças Cortadas
programme.desc: Morgan, uma bonita pirata que navega sob as ordens de seu pai, decide partir em busca de um fabuloso tesouro indicado num mapa que este lhe entregou antes de morrer.

programme.title: O Último Vermeer
programme.desc: Um soldado e membro da resistência holandesa investiga arte roubada na sequência da Segunda Guerra Mundial, incluindo um Vermeer vendido aos nazis por um famoso falsificador.

programme.title: Rambo III
programme.desc: John Rambo, hesita em acompanhar o velho amigo Coronel Trautman às linhas soviéticas no Afeganistão. Mas acabará por seguir, numa missão não-oficial de resgate na sequência da captura de Trautman.

programme.title: Confiança
programme.desc: A vida de Jake Vig pode depender do que não sabe. Este elegante jogador acaba de roubar milhares de dólares ao intocável Lionel Dolby. No entanto, quando Lionel e outro membro da equipa aparecem mortos, descobre-se que Lionel não é um homem qualquer.

programme.title: Os Croods
programme.desc: Uma aventura pré-histórica que acompanha a primeira família do Mundo. Depois de a caverna onde habitam ser destruída, os Croods iniciam uma viagem, durante a qual vão descobrir um incrível mundo novo, que lhes vai mudar a vida para sempre.

programme.title: Chovem Almôndegas
programme.desc: A última invenção de Flint Lockwood é um sucesso: ele faz chover comida do céu! Mas as coisas começam a correr mal quando, em vez de deliciosos hambúrgueres com queijo, começam a chover almôndegas gigantes, a alta velocidade, que ameaçam tudo e todos...

programme.title: Triplo Nove
programme.desc: Um gangue de criminosos e polícias corruptos planeia a morte de um oficial da Polícia, de modo a poderem realizar o maior golpe de sempre na cidade.

programme.title: Na Linha de Fogo
programme.desc: Frank Horrigan, agente dos Serviços Secretos, é perseguido pela culpa de não ter conseguido evitar a morte de Kennedy, nos anos 60. Quando um assassino lunático lhe liga, a ameaçar de morte o atual Presidente dos EUA, Frank faz tudo para o proteger.

programme.title: Os Bad Boys 2
programme.desc: Lowrey e Bennett, agentes da brigada de Narcóticos, lideram a equipa que investiga o tráfico de ecstasy para Miami. As buscas levam-nos a um perigoso traficante, cujo plano para controlar todo o tráfico na cidade desencadeou uma guerra no submundo da droga.

programme.title: Mare Vermelha
programme.desc: Depois do motim de uns rebeldes russos numa base com armamento nuclear, os Estados Unidos decidem enviar o submarino Alabama em missão de reconhecimento.

programme.title: Rapaz A
programme.desc: Jack Burridge, um assassino de crianças condenado, encontra trabalho como estafeta. Um jornal local descobre o seu passado, e Jack vê-se confrontado com a raiva e o medo dos habitantes pela segurança dos seus filhos.

programme.title: Sleepers - Sentimento de Revolta
programme.desc: Depois de uma partida terminar em tragédia, quatro amigos são enviados para um centro correcional, onde são brutalizados. Dez anos depois, já em liberdade, têm a oportunidade de se vingarem de quem lhes fez mal.

programme.title: O Universo no Olhar
programme.desc: Um biólogo molecular e o companheiro de laboratório descobrem evidências que podem alterar a sociedade tal como a conhecemos.

programme.title: O Carro da Polícia
programme.desc: Dois miúdos encontram um carro da polícia abandonado e decidem aprender a guiá-lo. Mas quando o corrupto xerife da cidade decide reavê-lo, os três envolvem-se numa corrida eletrizante onde vale tudo.

programme.title: Psico II
programme.desc: Depois de 22 anos de cuidados psiquiátricos, Norman Bates tenta regressar a uma vida solitária, mas o espectro dos seus crimes - e a sua mãe - continuam a assombrá-lo....

programme.title: Os Bad Boys
programme.desc: Burnett e Lowrey, polícias de Miami, têm de encontrar 100 milhões de dólares de heroína, roubada de um armazém da Polícia. Numa corrida contra o tempo, os detetives seguem a pista da única testemunha do caso, Julie Mott, e de Fouchet, um super ladrão.

programme.title: O Massacre
programme.desc: Expulso do FBI, Mark Kaminsky é contratado pelo xerife de uma pequena cidade para matar o assassino do filho. Mas, para isso, Kaminsky tem de se infiltrar nos meandros da Máfia de Chicago.

programme.title: Confiança
programme.desc: A vida de Jake Vig pode depender do que não sabe. Este elegante jogador acaba de roubar milhares de dólares ao intocável Lionel Dolby. No entanto, quando Lionel e outro membro da equipa aparecem mortos, descobre-se que Lionel não é um homem qualquer.

programme.title: Passageiros
programme.desc: Uma nave espacial, com destino a uma colónia distante, tem um problema nas câmaras de sono e dois passageiros acordam, 90 anos antes da chegada ao destino. Ameaçados pelo iminente colapso da nave, tentam descobrir o porquê de terem acordado.

programme.title: Dead Man Down - Um Homem a Abater
programme.desc: Victor, braço direito de Alphonse, líder de uma organização criminosa, é perseguido por alguém que está a matar os membros do gangue e que envia notas ameaçadoras. Darcy, que também trabalha para Alphonse, fica obcecado em apanhar o assassino.

programme.title: Para além do Horizonte
programme.desc: Chris, Annie e os filhos formam uma família feliz. Mas Chris morre e vai para o Céu. Uns anos depois, Annie suicida-se e vai parar ao Inferno. Chris, que esperava por ela no Paraíso, parte numa jornada para a salvar. Filme vencedor de um Oscar® em 1999.

programme.title: Rambo III
programme.desc: John Rambo, hesita em acompanhar o velho amigo Coronel Trautman às linhas soviéticas no Afeganistão. Mas acabará por seguir, numa missão não-oficial de resgate na sequência da captura de Trautman.

programme.title: Jackie Brown
programme.desc: A hospedeira Jackie Brown concebe um plano audacioso para se apoderar de uma grande soma de dinheiro, que pertence a um poderoso traficante de armas.

programme.title: Greenberg
programme.desc: Ben Stiller é Greenberg - solteiro, de quarenta e tal anos, que nada faz deliberadamente - nesta comédia inteligente, engraçada e comovente que os críticos dizem ser extremamente divertida.

programme.title: Whitney Houston: I Wanna Dance With Somebody
programme.desc: Uma celebração da vida e da música de Whitney Houston, uma das maiores artistas femininas de R&B, de todos os tempos. Desde o seu início como cantora de coro em Nova Jersey, até ao estrelato, num filme repleto de sucessos musicais inesquecíveis.

programme.title: Olha Que Duas
programme.desc: Quando o namorado a deixa, antes das férias exóticas programadas, Emily Middleton convence a ultra cautelosa mãe a viajar com ela até ao paraíso. E o resultado é, no mínimo, inesperado...

Elisa
Elisa di Rivombrosa
programme.desc:
Frumoasa Elisa Scalzi, dama de companie
a contesei Ristori, se îndrăgosteşte de fiul acesteia, Fabrizio. Din
păcate, diferenţa mare de rang şi de avere face imposibilă căsătoria
celor doi tineri. Intrigile familiei îi vor pune la încercare pe Elisa
şi Fabrizio, care vor trece prin nenumărate aventuri până să-şi
găsească fericirea. Dar, în cele din urmă, în ciuda diferenţelor
sociale şi a imixtiunilor celor răuvoitori, dragostea va iesi
triumfătoare.

programme.title: Sclava Isaura
A Escrava Isaura
programme.desc: Remake dupa cunoscuta serie din 1976, serialul se constituie intr-o tumultoasa istorie a vietii sclavei Isaura, o tanara de culoare alba.\n\nNascuta in 1885, la ferma comandantului Almeida din Campos, tanara Isaura este fiica frumoasei sclave Juliana si a administratorului fermei Miguel. Viata Isaurei la ferma devine din ce in ce mai dificila, cand Leoncio, fiul lui Alemida, se intoarce acasa. Acesta se indragosteste nebuneste de Isaura!

programme.title: 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple
programme.desc: Dr Kelson finds himself in a shocking new relationship with consequences that could change the world as he knows it. Horror sequel, starring Ralph Fiennes, Jack O'Connell and Alfie Williams.

programme.title: The Evil Dead
programme.desc: Five students staying in a remote cabin find an ancient magical book, and unwittingly unleash evil spirits on the world. The dark forces they have conjured up possess them one by one, transforming them into ravenous zombies with an insatiable desire to feast on the living. Sam Raimi's horror, starring Bruce Campbell and Ellen Sandweiss.

programme.title: Evil Dead II
programme.desc: Hapless Ash takes his girlfriend to a remote cabin in the woods, only for her to be killed and possessed by evil spirits. As a motley group of strangers turns up, they too find themselves under attack from demonic entities, leaving Ash the task of fending off the forces of darkness with his trusty chainsaw. Sam Raimi's comedy horror sequel, starring Bruce Campbell and Sarah Berry.

programme.title: Get Out
programme.desc: After African American photographer Chris and his white girlfriend Rose visit her wealthy parents, he suspects there's more to the locals than meets the eye. Oscar-winning psychological thriller written and directed by Jordan Peele (Us), starring Daniel Kaluuya, Allison Williams, Bradley Whitford and Caleb Landry Jones.

programme.title: Sick
programme.desc: Due to the pandemic, Parker and her best friend decide to quarantine at the family lake house alone - or so they think. Horror, starring Gideon Adlon, Bethlehem Million and Dylan Spradberry.

programme.title: Lake Placid
programme.desc: A palaeontologist, a game warden, a conspiracy theorist and a redneck sheriff each set out to investigate a mysterious death on the shore of a lake, only to find themselves up against a man-eating 30ft crocodile with an insatiable appetite. Comedy horror, starring Bill Pullman, Bridget Fonda, Oliver Platt, Brendan Gleeson and Betty White.

programme.title: We Bury the Dead
programme.desc: When an experimental military weapon accidentally devastates Tasmania, volunteers travel to the island to help authorities identify the dead. Among them is a Ava Newman, who secretly hopes to find her missing husband. However, some of the bodies seem to be returning to life. Horror, starring Daisy Ridley, Brenton Thwaites and Mark Coles Smith.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: A dull American town in the middle of the desert is suddenly attacked by huge man-eating subterranean creatures. Luckily, two dim-witted but brave handymen step into the breach to lead a ragtag bunch of locals and a mismatched pair of survivalists in the battle against the gruesome worm-like monsters. Comedy horror, with Kevin Bacon, Fred Ward, Finn Carter, Michael Gross, Reba McEntire and Bobby Jacoby.

programme.title: Anaconda
programme.desc: Film-makers venture deep into the Amazon jungle to document the lives of a remote tribe. However, the expedition is hijacked by a crazed hunter who plans to use them as bait to catch a gigantic killer snake. Adventure, starring Jennifer Lopez, Jon Voight, Ice Cube, Eric Stoltz and Jonathan Hyde.

programme.title: The Lost Boys
programme.desc: Two teenage brothers move with their mother to a coastal town in California, where the eldest falls in with a local biker gang. He soon discovers that his new friends are vampires and he is turning into one himself, forcing his younger brother to team up with a pair of heavily armed comic shop employees to battle the undead and save his soul. Comedy horror, starring Kiefer Sutherland, Jason Patric, Dianne Wiest, Corey Feldman and Corey Haim.

programme.title: Heretic
programme.desc: Two young missionaries are forced to prove their faith when they knock on the wrong door and are greeted by the diabolical Mr Reed. Horror, starring Hugh Grant, Sophie Thatcher and Chloe East.

programme.title: Nosferatu
programme.desc: In 1838 Germany, Thomas Hutter is sent to the Carpathian mountains to secure the signature of enigmatic nobleman Count Orlok on a property sale in the German city of Wisborg. Thomas leaves his bride Ellen in the care of friend Friedrich Harding and his wife Anna. The young man barely survives the exhausting trip to Europe and stumbles home to find Ellen driven to delirium by a telepathic bond to the Count. Director Robert Eggers' version of the Dracula-inspired horror, starring Bill Skarsgard, Lily-Rose Depp, Nicholas Hoult and Aaron Taylor-Johnson.

programme.title: The Woman in the Yard
programme.desc: Inside a rural farmhouse, painter Ramona Harris recuperates with a leg brace following a head-on car collision that claimed the life of her husband. Out of the blue, a woman in funereal garb materialises in a chair on the front lawn of the fixer-upper, and she has no intention of leaving. Psychological horror, starring Danielle Deadwyler, Peyton Jackson and Estella Kahiha.

programme.title: Insidious: The Last Key
programme.desc: A parapsychologist returns to her family home to investigate supernatural disturbances. Fourth instalment in the horror saga, starring Lin Shaye, Angus Sampson, Leigh Whannell and Spencer Locke.

programme.title: Sinners
programme.desc: Hoping to escape their troubled pasts, twin brothers return to their hometown to start over, only to find an even darker force waiting to welcome them back. Writer/director Ryan Coogler's Oscar-winning horror thriller, starring Michael B Jordan, Miles Caton and Saul Williams.

programme.title: Event Horizon
programme.desc: A deep-space salvage crew investigate mysterious events aboard a hi-tech spaceship, which suddenly reappeared in orbit around Neptune after going missing for seven years - but it is not long before they are exposed to terror beyond their wildest nightmares. Sci-fi horror, starring Laurence Fishburne, Sam Neill, Kathleen Quinlan, Joely Richardson and Sean Pertwee.

programme.title: Halloween
programme.desc: Four decades ago, Michael Myers terrorised the town of Haddonfield, Illinois and went on a killing spree, 15 years after murdering his sister. After a prison bus crashes, the killer is back in the wild, but survivor Laurie Strode is ready for his return. Director David Gordon Green's horror sequel based on John Carpenter's much imitated 1978 namesake movie, starring Jamie Lee Curtis, Judy Greer and Andi Matichak.

programme.title: Critters
programme.desc: Murderous alien beasties escape from their space prison and flee to Earth, where they wreak havoc in a sleepy Kansas village as they discover the delights of snacking on human flesh - and only two intergalactic bounty hunters look capable of saving the day. Madcap horror comedy, starring Dee Wallace Stone, M Emmet Walsh, Billy Green Bush and Scott Grimes.

programme.title: It Feeds
programme.desc: After a young girl bursts into their home psychiatry practice claiming an entity is feeding on her, Jordan and her clairvoyant mother must find a way to stop the evil. Horror, starring Shawn Ashmore and Ashley Greene.

programme.title: Anacondas: The Hunt for the Blood Orchid
programme.desc: A team of scientists and a soldier of fortune comb the Borneo jungle for a rare species of orchid with valuable medicinal properties, but get more than they bargained when they encroach on the territory of a nest of gigantic and deadly snakes. Thriller, starring Johnny Messner, Matthew Marsden, KaDee Strickland and Nicholas Gonzalez.

programme.title: A Fistful of Dynamite
programme.desc: At the beginning of the Mexican Revolution in 1913, greedy bandit Juan Miranda and idealist John H. Mallory, an Irish Republican Army explosives expert on the lam from the British, fall in with a band of revolutionaries plotting to strike a national bank. When it turns out that the government has been using the bank as a hiding place for illegally detained political prisoners, who are freed by the blast, Miranda becomes a revolutionary hero against his will.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: A Reason to Live, A Reason to Die
programme.desc: After surrendering Fort Holman to the Confederacy without there being a single shot fired, Col. Pembroke (James Coburn) faces public disgrace and a potential court-martial unless he's able to recapture the fort now held by the power-mad Maj. Ward (Telly Savalas). To help him on this mission, Pembroke enlists a ragtag bunch of condemned men who are promised their freedom should they survive. Despite much internal strife, the group gradually comes together in time for the assault.

programme.title: The Honkers
programme.desc: An aging rodeo rider (James Coburn) thinks more of himself than he does of his wife (Lois Nettleton), son and best friend (Slim Pickens).

programme.title: The Great Scout & Cathouse Thursday
programme.desc: The year is 1908, and aging adventurer Sam Longwood (Lee Marvin) and his gang of crooked cowboys have been cheated out of a big score by their own cohort, Jack Colby (Robert Culp). After years of searching, Sam finally tracks Colby down and decides to take revenge against his former accomplice. Sam regroups his old circle of grifters, and they hatch a scheme to get their hands on Colby's fortune; however, nothing seems to go smoothly for these ramshackle scam artists.

programme.title: Day of the Outlaw
programme.desc: In the quiet frontier town of Bitters, Wyo., a dispute between cattleman Blaise Starrett and farmer Hal Crane is about to boil over into a bloody feud. But the fighting takes a back seat to a new threat when a rogue cavalry captain, Jack Bruhn, rides into town with his band of thugs. Now, with the citizens of Bitters held hostage by Bruhn and his men, Starrett must somehow rescue his town and restore his broken reputation.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: The Gunfight at Dodge City
programme.desc: Gambler and gunman Bat Masterson (Joel McCrea) rides into Dodge City, Kan., to visit his straight-arrow brother, Ed (Harry Lauter), who is hoping to defeat crooked sheriff Jim Regan (Don Haggerty) in an upcoming election. Bat purchases and renovates a rundown saloon, attracting the notice of Regan's henchmen. A shooting during the saloon's opening-night celebration causes Bat to pursue his own political vendetta against Regan and attempt to clean up the town's corruption once and for all.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Robbers' Roost
programme.desc: An outlaw attempting to go straight while tracking down one of his wife's killers, Jim "Tex" Wall (George Montgomery) finds work on a ranch operated by disabled cattle owner "Bull" Herrick (Bruce Bennett). As Tex begins to fall for Bull's pretty sister, Helen (Sylvia Findley), he also has to face off against two feuding gangs of rustlers, one led by the tough Heesman (Peter Graves). Can Tex escape his shady past and finally end his mission of vengeance?

programme.title: Navajo Joe
programme.desc: Proud warrior Navajo Joe (Burt Reynolds) is the only man left alive when outlaw Marvin Duncan (Aldo Sambrell) and his brutal gang destroy his village. Riding into a nearby town of white settlers, Joe announces his plans for vengeance, but the townspeople fear Duncan's retribution too much to stand behind him. In the course of his one-man battle against Duncan's small army for control of the town, Joe falls for beautiful maid Estella (Nicoletta Machiavelli).

programme.title: Sam Whiskey
programme.desc: Great gambler Sam Whiskey (Burt Reynolds) has got his hands on a heist job that's pretty outrageous, even by Wild West standards. programme.title: Woman on the Run
programme.desc: After witnessing a murder, Frank Johnson goes on the run to avoid being killed himself. His wife, Eleanor (Ann Sheridan), seems almost apathetic about finding him when questioned by Investigator Harris (Robert Keith), due to a marriage on the rocks. However, after learning that Frank has a grave heart condition, Eleanor recruits reporter Dan Leggett (Dennis O'Keefe) to help track down Frank. Discovering new love for her husband along the way, Eleanor must get to Frank before the killer does.

programme.title: The Bigamist
programme.desc: San Francisco businessman Harry Graham (Edmond O'Brien) and his wife and business partner, Eve (Joan Fontaine), are in the process of adopting a child. When private investigator Jordan (Edmund Gwenn) uncovers the fact that Graham has another wife, Phyllis (Ida Lupino), and a small child in Los Angeles, he confesses everything. In flashback, Graham tells of the strains in his marriage with Eve and how he found himself falling for the kind-hearted waitress Phyllis while on a business trip.

programme.desc: After witnessing a murder, Frank Johnson goes on the run to avoid being killed himself. Discovering new love for her husband along the way, Eleanor must get to Frank before the killer does.

programme.desc: San Francisco businessman Harry Graham (Edmond O'Brien) and his wife and business partner, Eve (Joan Fontaine), are in the process of adopting a child. programme.title: The Uninvited
programme.desc: After spending time in a psychiatric facility, young Anna (Emily Browning) finds significant changes in store at home. Her widowed father (David Strathairn) is now engaged to her mother's former nurse, Rachel (Elizabeth Banks). One night, the ghost of Anna's mother appears, screaming for revenge and accusing Rachel of murder. Anna and her sister, Alex (Arielle Kebbel), start to investigate, but they may be unprepared for the lethal battle of wills that ensues.

programme.title: The Talented Mr. Ripley
programme.desc: To be young and carefree amid the blue waters and idyllic landscape of sun-drenched Italy in the late 1950s; that's la dolce vita Tom Ripley (Matt Damon) craves- and Dickie Greenleaf (Jude Law) leads. When Dickie's father asks Tom to bring his errant playboy son back home to America, Dickie and his beautiful expatriate girlfriend, Marge Sherwood (Gwyneth Paltrow), never suspect the dangerous extremes to which Ripley will go to make their lifestyle his own.

programme.title: Fatal Attraction
programme.desc: For Dan Gallagher (Michael Douglas), life is good. He is on the rise at his New York law firm, is happily married to his wife, Beth (Anne Archer), and has a loving daughter. But, after a casual fling with a sultry book editor named Alex (Glenn Close), everything changes. Jilted by Dan, Alex becomes unstable, her behavior escalating from aggressive pursuit to obsessive stalking. Dan realizes that his main problem is not hiding his affair, but rather saving himself and his family.

programme.title: A Perfect Murder
programme.desc: Wall Street baron Steven Taylor (Michael Douglas) discovers that his pretty young wife, Emily (Gwyneth Paltrow), is cheating on him. But what concerns him more than her infidelity is the hope of profiting from her untimely death. Emily has millions, and Steve's own financial empire is collapsing before his eyes. He hires her lover, David (Viggo Mortensen), to murder her. The plan -- to stage a break-in that will look like a random murder -- turns out to be far from perfect.

programme.title: Double Jeopardy
programme.desc: Framed for the murder of her husband, Libby Parsons (Ashley Judd) survives the long years in prison with two burning desires sustaining her -- finding her son and solving the mystery that destroyed her once-happy life. Standing between her and her quest, however, is her parole officer, Travis Lehman (Tommy Lee Jones). Libby poses a challenge to the cynical officer, one that forces him to face up to his own failings while pitting him against his superiors and law enforcement colleagues.

"The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: Match Game
programme.desc: Gene Rayburn hosts this comedy-game show hybrid in which contestants try to match answers given by celebrities to humorous, and often risque, fill-in-the-blank questions. The contestant with the most points at the end of the game advances to play the bonus round, in which the contestant has a chance to win thousands of dollars, with the actual amount dependent on the rules in place at the time of the episode.

programme.title: Super Password
programme.desc: Like the 1960s version, two contestants, each teamed with a celebrity partner, compete in a word-association game. One player tries to guess a word based on clues offered by his or her partner. The game is timed, and if the clue-giver inadvertently says part of the word, a buzzer sounds and that round is lost. The team with the most points at the end of the round gets to go on to a fast-paced bonus round called Cashword.

programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.title: Family Feud
programme.desc: In this original version of iconic game show "Family Feud," actor Richard Dawson plays host to two teams, each comprised of five family members, who try to match the answers given to survey questions asked to groups of people (typically 100 people in the group). The family that wins the game by being the first to reach a certain point total, either 200 or 300 depending on the rules at the time, advances to the bonus round, called Fast Money, for a chance to win thousands of dollars by answering more survey questions.

programme.title: Sue Thomas F.B.Eye
programme.desc: This light-hearted police drama follows a sheltered deaf woman who is about to start her first real job with the FBI. When she is given the tedious task of analyzing fingerprints, Sue is disappointed but doesn't remain there for long. An FBI agent discovers her ability to read lips and promotes Sue to an elite surveillance team. Suddenly, Sue and her hearing dog, Levi, are "G-Men," involved in a lot more action than they bargained for. This series is loosely based on the real-life deaf FBI agent Sue Thomas.

programme.title: Greatest American Hero
programme.desc: While on a road trip through a desert, mild-mannered high-school teacher Ralph Hinkley (temporarily changed to Ralph Hanley for part of season one due to real-life current events) is greeted by extraterrestrials, who present him with an extraordinary red flying suit that imbues him with uncanny powers. Learning of the suit, high-strung FBI agent Bill Maxwell convinces Ralph to help him fight crime. Ralph's girlfriend, attorney Pam Davidson, also knows of his secret life as a superhero.

programme.desc: As a teenager, African-American Joe Louis (Coley Wallace) gives up on the violin to try his hand at boxing. A few years later, he's the 1934 Golden Gloves champion. He goes pro, trains with Chappie Blackburn (James Edwards), and enjoys an unprecedented string of victories. But Louis faces more than just tough opponents in the ring. As more people die, Suzy uncovers the terrifying secret history of the place.

programme.desc: Douglas Quaid is a bored construction worker in the year 2084 who dreams of visiting colonized Mars. programme.title: Hot Bench
programme.desc: Many popular court shows are on TV. How can the genre improve? How about using a three-judge panel? That's the concept of "Hot Bench," created by Judge Judy Sheindlin. After hearing each case, the judges discuss it among themselves before rendering a verdict. The jurists are experienced civil litigator Tanya Acker, New York State Supreme Court Justice Patricia DiMango, and former criminal defense attorney Larry Bakman. The show's title comes from a term describing a court action in which a judge frequently interrupts lawyers with questions.

During the chase, Tommy is killed by Jack, and Roy and Rusty decide to cross the border into Mexico to find the outlaw. But Jack has plenty of reinforcements waiting, and Roy and Rusty may be in over their heads.

programme.title: Riders of Destiny
programme.desc: Loner government agent Singin' Sandy Saunders (John Wayne) witnesses what seems to be a stagecoach robbery, committed by young Fay Denton (Cecelia Parker). But Fay is actually just trying to get her hands back on her own money in order to keep it from thieving stooges Bert (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) and Elmer (Heinie Conklin) and their boss, local land grabber James Kincaid (Forrest Taylor). Saunders then teams up with Kay to fight off the gang and derail the criminal plots of the greedy Kincaid.

programme.title: The Cowboy and the Indians
programme.desc: Rancher Gene Autry tries to aid neighboring Navajos suffering from malnutrition, but he is opposed by a crafty and crooked trading post proprietor.

programme.title: Don't Wait, Django... Shoot!
programme.desc: Django believes there is only one path for him to follow when he returns to his hometown and discovers his father has been murdered by a ruthless gang.

programme.title: Oklahoma Annie
programme.desc: Judy Canova (Judy Canova) is a capable cowgirl and a sassy shopkeeper in her frontier town. But, once she spies the dashing new town sheriff, Dan Fraser (John Russell), Judy decides to branch out into catching crooks to garner his notice. With her daring behavior and bravery, she soon earns a deputy's badge, allowing her to spend time with her favorite lawman. But, when Dan is abducted by a band of wild outlaws, it's up to Judy to round up a posse and save the day.

programme.title: Stagecoach Outlaws
programme.desc: Cowboy Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe) enrages saloon owner Steve Kirby (Stanford Jolley) when he thwarts a bank robbery by Kirby's crew. But Kirby has more schemes up his sleeve. He sends his men to bust brutish outlaw Matt Brawley (Bob Kortman) out of jail for a new heist. When a case of mistaken identities leads to the bandits freeing harmless Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) instead, he decides to play along to help Billy. However, the real Brawley soon arrives to cause trouble.

programme.title: Stage to Mesa City
programme.desc: Valiant U.S. Marshal Cheyenne Davis (Al "Lash" La Rue) and his trusty deputy, Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), are on their way to aid a stagecoach owner who is mired in financial burdens. But, when they arrive and discover he's been murdered, the loyal pair are asked by Margie (Jennifer Holt), his daughter, to seek out his killers and make them pay for their vile crime. The investigation soon leads them to a sneering lawyer (Marshall Reed), who has a mysterious boss.

programme.title: Lightning Raiders
programme.desc: When his mail doesn't get delivered one day, Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) is suspicious. He enlists the help of his friend Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe) to find out what happened. The duo discovers that the postal stagecoach has been held up by Frank Hayden (Steve Darrell) and his band of thieves, and that the criminals are in hiding. It's up to Fuzzy and Billy to stop the thieves before they make off with the stolen mail -- and with the money and secrets that it contains.

programme.title: Susanna Pass
programme.desc: After finding a large oil bed underneath a lake, crooked engineer Del Roberts (Douglas Fowley) plots to take control of a fish hatchery run by Russell Masters (Lucien Littlefield), brother of Roberts' accomplice, Martin Masters (Robert Emmett Keane). Acting sheriff Roy (Roy Rogers) and his deputies square off against Roberts and his henchmen, and visiting female ichthyologist "Doc" Parker (Dale Evans) is caught in the crossfire between the opposing camps.

programme.title: The Carson City Kid
programme.desc: The Carson City Kid (Roy Rogers) stops stagecoaches traveling between Wild West mining towns, searching their mail sacks for letters addressed to Morgan Reynolds, the man who killed his brother. Discovering that Reynolds operates a saloon under the name Lee Jessup (Bob Steele), the Kid takes a job as the saloon's bouncer. While vying with Reynolds for the affections of singer Joby Madison (Pauline Moore), the Kid discovers a swindled miner (Noah Beery Jr.) who claims to be the Carson City Kid.

programme.title: Driftin' River
programme.desc: The cavalry asks cowboy Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) to inspect 300 horses they're looking to purchase from J.C. Morgan (Shirley Patterson), to assist the Army in battling outlaw attacks on railroad construction workers. Eddie and friend Soapy (Roscoe Ates) visit J.C.'s ranch, unaware that the attacks are being conducted by outlaw Marino (Dennis Moore), who owns the town saloon. Fearing the rail expansion will end his stage business, Marino attacks J.C.'s horses, and she turns to Eddie for help.

programme.title: Lockup: Long Island: Extended Stay
programme.desc: A first time inmate says he must turn to violence to avoid becoming a victim, an accused rapist gets into more trouble in jail and what he does next has some questioning his motives.

programme.title: Lockup: Charleston: Extended Stay
programme.desc: An agitated inmate takes severe measures to get staff's attention; a young first-timer is found unconscious in his cell; another inmate garners "enemy status" within the jail.

programme.title: Lockup: Orange County: Extended Stay
programme.desc: Inside the Orange County Jail a senior inmate takes up rap; a gang member poses a threat; another inmate makes the most shocking confession ever heard on Lockup.

programme.title: American Greed
programme.desc: Brothers Darain and Cory Atkinson start a business selling vehicle service contracts, but the warranties prove worthless and the brothers pocket millions.

programme.title: American Greed
programme.desc: A man sets his sights on strip clubs, real estate, Iraqi currency, diamonds and even mind control technology.

programme.title: Lockup Special Investigation
programme.sub-title: Lake County Juvenile Justice: Aaron, Ayryana, Marie
programme.desc: Figuring out what contributes to kids getting locked up is not an exact science; over the past six years, Aaron has become a familiar face at Lake County Juvenile; with his 18th birthday just days away, he finds himself back behind bars.

programme.title: Lockup: Orange County: Extended Stay
programme.desc: Confinement takes a dark turn for a light-hearted teenager, but provides a new beginning for an old bank robber inside the Orange County Jail; a mother who has put drugs before her son gets another chance.

programme.title: Lockup: Orange County: Extended Stay
programme.desc: The Emergency Response Team have their hands full of a sadistic murderer who transforms the jail, a roller derby queen who takes a hard fall and one inmate who realizes that even a good day in jail can have a dark side.

programme.title: Lockup: Tampa: Extended Stay
programme.desc: An inmate with suspicious tax forms becomes a problem for the jail, and a murder ends with the victim burned alive in a dumpster, pitting friends and family against each other.

programme.title: Lockup: Charleston: Extended Stay
programme.desc: The survivor of a vicious attack shares his story in the hopes that other inmates will never commit such violence; for another inmate, it's too late to turn back the clock and now the pain of incarceration has begun to take a toll.

programme.title: Lockup: Cincinnati: Extended Stay
programme.desc: An online post from a diehard Dodgers fan leads to his arrest at a Reds game; a tragic shooting leaves one inmate facing prison time and outrage over his punishment leads to more arrests.

programme.desc: A low-level offender increases his sentence from 18 months to 16-and-a-half years after three separate counts of aggravated battery on an officer; the same inmate was banned from even non-contact visits after an affair with a prison staff nurse.

programme.title: Lockup: New Mexico: Extended Stay
programme.desc: Inmates who become disruptive at the Penitentiary of New Mexico are transferred to the lock-up units in level 5 or 6; the trouble is, their behavior doesn't always improve; this is a lesson rookie officer Amy Lee is learning the hard way.

programme.title: Lockup: New Mexico: Extended Stay

programme.title: Into the Blue
programme.desc: Charter boat captains Steve Rodger and Scott Walker combine their distinctly different fishing styles and skills to produce this action-packed offshore fishing series. Rodger has a lifetime of fishing and diving experience in the waters surrounding the Florida Keys, and many "Into the Blue" episodes feature his underwater videography as he hunts for the ocean's predators. Walker is a proven performer in big-game billfish tournaments and has fished the waters of the Florida Keys and the Mid-Atlantic for more than 25 years. Together, in the search for yellowfin tuna, red snapper, sharks, sailfish, mahi-mahi or marlin, they demonstrate how to make an offshore fishing adventure a success.

programme.desc: Just about everybody likes animals and doesn't like to see animals who are sick, injured or abused. programme.desc: Dogs are said to be man's best friend so is it a surprise that there's a weekly show dedicated to dogs and the people who love them? That's what "Dog Tales" is all about. It also provides safety, health and training tips that are useful for different breeds of dogs as well as emphasizing responsible pet ownership and compassion for all living creatures.

programme.title: America's Black Forum
programme.desc: Political analyst Marc Morial hosts a weekly syndicated newsmagazine series featuring in-depth and engaging interviews with newsmakers, influencers, business entrepreneurs, artists, health and wellness experts and social justice leaders. Targeted to an African American audience, "America's Black Forum" was an hourlong production from 1977 to 2006. It has been revived as a 30-minute series after being off the air for 15 years, but has maintained the same format.

Their ability to survive will determine the shape of life on Earth and whether humans will exist at all. As our amphibian ancestors struggle onto land the monsters they face are even more deadly.

programme.title: Walking with Monsters: Life Before Dinosaurs
programme.desc: Part 2/3. Millions of years before the dinosaurs, a world full of giant sabretooth reptiles and huge armoured herbivores was obliterated when global temperatures soared and vast deserts blanketed the land. As the environment recovered, populations of one species of tough reptile exploded until it alone dominated the planet, but its reign was short-lived.

programme.title: Walking with Monsters: Life Before Dinosaurs
programme.desc: Part 3/3. The struggle for survival moves onto land in the shape of early reptiles such as Petrolacosaurus. In the Carboniferous swamps, insects and arthropods have taken over and grown into giants, from the giant spider Mesothelae to millipede-like monsters. As the swamps dry up, the world becomes dominated by the first ever giant reptiles - the huge, sail-backed Edaphosaurus.

programme.title: Tutankhamun: Life, Death and Legacy
programme.desc: Dan meets the mummies of Tutankhamun's parents at the Egyptian Museum in Cairo, and discovers that they were actually brother and sister. CT scans reveal how this incestuous relationship could have been responsible for Tutankhamun's poor health. Raksha heads underground to a rare tomb excavation in the Valley of the Kings which has never been seen before on television.

programme.desc: 1 Timothy 4:1 states, “… that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits, and doctrines of devils.” And John 4:23 is very clear where it says, “… that the hour cometh, and now is, when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and in truth …” And where do we find truth friends? The Bible puts it this way, “For precept must be upon precept, precept upon precept; line upon line, line upon line; here a little, and there a little.” Isaiah 28:10. We need to learn to rightly divide the Word of God and learn its teachings in order to discern truth from error. 2 Timothy 2:15 admonishes ALL of us to, “Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth”! Without the proper study of God’ s Word through the guidance of the Holy Spirit, men are led down paths of legalism, devilish doctrines, and wrong interpretations of truth that is often presented to them by wolves in sheep’s clothing.

programme.title: 3ABN Hoy
programme.sub-title: Testimonio personal del Pr. José Feliciano Castillo Lugo
programme.desc: En esta inspiradora entrevista, el Pastor José Feliciano Castillo Lugo comparte profundamente su testimonio personal. Inicia relatando su infancia en Castaños, Coahuila (México), marcada por el alcoholismo de su padre. Sin embargo, tras “un último trago”, su padre decidió darle una oportunidad a Cristo. Este paso lo llevó a la Iglesia Adventista del Séptimo Día local, donde se bautizó y experimentó una transformación total, convirtiéndose en un ejemplo de rectitud para su familia. El Pr. Castillo continúa narrando su etapa como universitario, un periodo lleno de adversidades, frustraciones y desafíos. A pesar de ello, afirma que Dios lo sostuvo y lo ayudó a superar cada obstáculo. En ese proceso, Dios le mostró los “caminos torcidos” en los que viví a, y él tomó la decisión de enderezar sus pasos para honrar a Dios. Esta experiencia de cambio lo llevó finalmente al ministerio. Después de servir como oficial en México, hoy es evangelista y pastor en el estado de Tennessee, donde continúa compartiendo el mensaje de esperanza. Está casado con KeSardis, quien lo acompaña en el ministerio, y juntos crían a sus tres hijas. La entrevista es un testimonio poderoso de cómo Dios transforma vidas y abre nuevos comienzos. Para más historias de transformación y una amplia programación cristiana, puede descargar gratuitamente la aplicación 3ABN+ y suscribirse al canal 3ABN Latino en YouTube.

programme.title: Flash Gordon
programme.desc: The vintage sci-fi comic strip character gets a 21st-century makeover in this freewheeling adaptation that sends All-American track star Steven "Flash" Gordon on a series of wild adventures that begins when he falls through an interdimensional rift in space and lands on the planet Mongo, accompanied by his old flame from high school, Dale Arden. Flash is looking for clues to the fate of his father, the eminent scientist Dr. Lawrence Gordon, previously believed to have died in a laboratory fire several years earlier. His quest, however, leads him into the clutches of Ming, the evil ruler of Mongo, and his devious daughter, Aura. Flash escapes back to Earth, vowing to foil the ruthless Ming's threat to humanity. Fortunately, in addition to Dale, Flash can count on help from Baylin, a beautiful but tough intergalactic bounty hunter, and Hans Zarkov, the eccentric former associate of Flash's father.

programme.title: Xploration Awesome Planet
programme.desc: Philippe Cousteau Jr. is no stranger to exploration. The grandson of legendary underwater explorer Jacques Cousteau, Philippe hosts and serves as executive producer of this half-hour earth science series that examines the planet. He visits diamond and gold mines to see how gems and metals are formed, travels to active volcanoes to observe what happens inside the Earth's burning core, and checks out weather stations in mountainous areas to get an idea of how weather phenomena form in the atmosphere.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space
programme.desc: Americans have been fascinated by the cosmos for decades and rely on NASA to explore celestial bodies seen in the night sky to get a better idea of what is out there. In this series, former NASA employee Emily Calandrelli visits some of the agency's facilities, private companies and universities to speak with people knowledgeable about the topic to help "show off the coolest aspects of the space industry," to use her words. Technology, a potential manned mission to Mars and planetary tourism are some themes.

programme.title: Nature Knows Best
programme.desc: Marine biologist Danni Washington hosts this series that explains how nature has helped to inspire technology that people use on a daily basis. Some of the nature-inspired innovations include airplanes inspired by birds and helicopters that were influenced by dragonflies. The show also introduces viewers to people involved in creating innovations that are based on animals, including biologists who study the behavior of ants, architects designing "living buildings" and roboticists who are making their designs bigger and stronger based on animals.

The boys try to escape their harsh home life through fantasy, most of it centered on their Radio Flyer wagon. Inspired by the legend of another neighborhood boy, they hope to make it fly.

programme.title: Facing the Giants
programme.desc: A Christian high-school football coach (Alex Kendrick) inspires the players on his losing team through his steadfast belief in God.","large":"Grant Taylor, a Christian high-school football coach (Alex Kendrick), gets some very bad news. Besides his and his wife's (Shannen Fields) infertility problems, he faces the attempt of local parents to force the school to replace him. His team, the Shiloh Eagles, has never had a winning season in the six years that he has coached the boys. Following a visitor's message, Grant tries to inspire his team to use faith to conquer fear and opposing teams.

programme.title: The Deep
programme.desc: New Yorkers (Jacqueline Bisset, Nick Nolte) go scuba diving in Bermuda and find morphine from World War II on top of a Spanish galleon.","large":"Undersea adventure about a couple who become involved in a dangerous conflict with treasure hunters when they discover a deadly shipwreck in Bermudan waters. When they realize that the cache includes morphine, the pair enlist the help of an old treasure hunter to escape the drug dealers who hid their product amidst the sunken wreck.

programme.title: Darkness Falls
programme.desc: The spirit of a woman who was lynched more than 150 years earlier haunts residents (Emma Caulfield, Lee Cormie) of a New England town.","large":"In Maine, the residents of Darkness Falls are all aware of the legend of Matilda Dixon, an old woman who was tragically murdered by a mob in the 1800s because the townspeople thought she was killing children. Now Darkness Falls has to contend with Matilda's supernatural wrath. Childhood friends Kyle (Chaney Kley) and Caitlin (Emma Caulfield) return home to uncover the truth behind the legend after Caitlin's little brother (Lee Cormie) has recurring nightmares about Matilda.

programme.title: Red Water
programme.desc: A shark terrorizes a divorced couple (Lou Diamond Phillips, Kristy Swanson) and three boat hijackers on a Louisiana river.","large":"Former oil rig worker John Sanders (Lou Diamond Phillips) became a Louisiana fishing captain after a tragic accident ended his career. In need of money, he agrees to help his ex-wife, Kelli (Kristy Swanson), whose company is having trouble extracting oil upriver. Meanwhile, thugs working for a Jamaican gangster head to the same bayou searching for $3 million buried underwater. Both the scientists and the criminals are menaced by a man-eating shark that can survive in fresh water.

programme.title: Maximum Risk
programme.desc: Federal agents and the Russian Mafia chase a French policeman (Jean-Claude Van Damme) on a mission in New York City.","large":"French police officer Alain Moreau makes an astonishing discovery: Mikhail, a man who died recently in a breakneck car chase, is the twin brother he never knew. Alain then uncovers a web of family secrets that lead him to New York City, where his brother was involved with the Russian Mafia. Teaming up with Mikhail's lover, Alex Minetti, Alain must now assume his twin's identity and go undercover to avenge Mikhail's death.

programme.title: Sahara
programme.desc: An Army sergeant (James Belushi), his crew (Mark Lee, Paul Empson) and stragglers try to hold off a Nazi battalion at a Libyan waterhole.

programme.title: Felon
programme.desc: A new convict (Stephen Dorff) struggles to maintain his sanity and sense of humanity after he's thrust into a prison system in which a brutal guard (Harold Perrineau) encourages gladiatorial combat between inmates.

programme.title: The Take
programme.desc: During his rehabilitation after he is shot during a heist in East L.A., an armored truck driver tracks down the man who committed the crime.","large":"Deep in the slums of Los Angeles, good-natured Felix De La Pena (John Leguizamo), a family man and armored vehicle driver, is shot in the head during a hijacking attempt gone wrong. Though his wife, Marina (Rosie Perez), offers her love and support, Felix suffers from intense physical and emotional pain following the attack. As he begins to recover, he learns he has been framed for the stick-up; distraught, Felix decides to find the real culprit himself, despite his failing health and memory.

programme.title: U-Turn
programme.desc: A two-bit criminal (Sean Penn) meets an attractive woman (Jennifer Lopez) and her spouse (Nick Nolte), each of whom wants him to murder the other.

programme.title: Money Train
programme.desc: A New York transit officer (Woody Harrelson) fights subway crime with his foster brother (Wesley Snipes) and dreams of robbing the train carrying system revenue.","large":"Charlie (Woody Harrelson) is a New York City transit cop with a mountain of gambling debts, and John (Wesley Snipes) is his responsible, and frequently exasperated, foster brother. They compete amicably for the affections of fellow officer Grace (Jennifer Lopez), but things become more serious when Charlie decides to rob the "money train" that carries the Transit Authority's daily proceeds. John must decide whether to prevent Charlie's crime or to join in on the heist.

programme.title: Did You Hear About the Morgans?
programme.desc: A husband (Hugh Grant) and wife (Sarah Jessica Parker) get a chance to repair their crumbling marriage when, after they witness a murder, federal agents hide them in a tiny Wyoming town.","large":"New Yorkers Paul (Hugh Grant) and Meryl (Sarah Jessica Parker) Morgan seem to have it all -- except that their marriage is crumbling around them. But their romantic woes are small compared to the trouble they find themselves in after witnessing a murder. To protect them from an assassin, federal agents whisk away Paul and Meryl to a small town in Wyoming, where their marriage will crash and burn, or their passion will reignite.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: An actual witch (Nicole Kidman) and a neurotic movie star (Will Ferrell) land the lead roles in a television remake of the 1960s sitcom.","large":"Movie star Jack Wyatt (Will Ferrell) has hit a rough patch in his career. Looking to make a comeback, he signs on to play the role of Darrin in a movie version of the popular 1960s sitcom "Bewitched." Jack insists that an unknown is hired to play Darrin's better half, the beguiling witch-housewife Samantha, so the studio finds an up-and-comer named Isabel Bigelow (Nicole Kidman). Once shooting begins, though, Jack learns that Isabel was cast too well -- since she actually is a witch.

programme.title: Persuasion
programme.desc: When Frederick Wentworth -- the one who got away -- crashes back into Anne Elliot's life, she must choose between putting the past behind her or listening to her heart when it comes to second chances.

programme.title: Swept From the Sea
programme.desc: Locals disapprove of the love between an indentured servant (Rachel Weisz) and the shipwrecked Russian (Vincent Perez) she rescued in 19th-century England.","large":"Amy (Rachel Weisz), a maid in the house of wealthy Miss Swaffer (Kathy Bates), falls for a Russian stranger named Yanko (Vincent Perez) after his boat mistakenly washes up in the seaside village where she lives. Despite the villagers' wariness of Yanko, Amy cultivates a relationship with him, while Miss Swaffer's doctor, James (Ian McKellen), teaches him English. When Amy marries Yanko, despite the objections of James -- who secretly pines for the sailor -- tragedy lurks around the corner.

programme.title: Breakout
programme.desc: A woman (Jill Ireland) hires a bush pilot (Charles Bronson) to free her husband (Robert Duvall), framed for a murder, from a Mexican prison.

programme.title: Birdy
programme.desc: A Vietnam veteran helps his bird-obsessed boyhood buddy in a psychiatric hospital.

programme.title: The Shadow Riders
programme.desc: Two brothers who fought on opposite sides during the American Civil War return home to their family kidnapped by rebels. So now they put aside their differences to rescue them.","large":"Mac Traven (Tom Selleck) is a Civil War veteran who fought for the North, while his brother, Dal (Sam Elliott), was allied with the South. In spite of this considerable point of contention, the siblings must work together when they find that other family members have been abducted, along with Dal's girlfriend, Kate (Katharine Ross). Joined by their trouble-making uncle "Black Jack" (Ben Johnson), Mac and Dal relentlessly pursue the criminals to rescue their relatives.

programme.title: Murphy's Romance

Their friendship becomes complicated when Emma's ex-husband, Bobby Jack (Brian Kerwin), shows up. He claims to have changed his ways, but when he turns out to be the same man Emma divorced, she discovers her true feelings for Murphy.

programme.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: An FBI agent (Colin Hanks) must spy on his mother (Meg Ryan) after she becomes involved with a suspected art thief (Antonio Banderas).","large":"After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam
programme.sub-title: Fiery Chili Sauce in Hoi An

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam
programme.sub-title: Seafood With A Bang, Here In Da Nang
programme.desc: On this stop of his Vietnam journey, Luke visits the bustling seaside city of Da Nang. Join him as he visits the spectacular Dragon Bridge, looks up some succulent shrimp on the beach, and stumbles upon a tiny fishing village packed with restaurants.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam
programme.desc: Luke visits Huế - famous for its heritage and cuisine - and Con Hen Village to learn a technique for de-shelling baby clams, searches for best bowl of spicy beef noodle soup, and stops by a business where they make turmeric vermicelli noodle salad!

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam

Sent to elite training camps and active as a youth communist agitator, her life was following a familiar pattern. The fall of the Berlin Wall brings winds of change, which lead to encounters with Christians. She reads the Bible to gain ammunition against them, but tense debates eventually open into a horizonof new realities.

programme.desc: En Reflexión 360 analizamos los temas más relevantes de la actualidad desde una perspectiva bíblica. Este podcast está diseñado para jó venes y adultos que desean entender los eventos del mundo a la luz de la Palabra de Dios.

programme.title: En las manos de Dios
programme.desc: Generalmente cuando se habla de mayordomía se piensa en dinero. Pero el tema de la mayordomía es mucho más abarcante pues incluye todas las dimensiones de la vida--el tiempo, los talentos, la influencia, la salud y los recursos materiales. En esta serie el Pastor Jorge Sá nchez presenta el tema de la mayordomía desde una perspectiva amplia, profunda y sencilla.

programme.title: Me gustaría saber
programme.sub-title: ¿Fue Alterada la Fórmula Bautismal del Padre, Hijo y Espíritu Santo?
programme.desc: Preguntas frecuentes sobre temas doctrinales, teológicos y prácticos respondidas con base en la Biblia y el Espíritu de Profecía.

programme.title: Ancla 2018: El mensaje de los tres angeles
programme.desc: En esta clase de 20 sesiones estudiaremos frase por frase los mensajes de los tres ángeles. La iglesia adventista existe por una sola razón y es para proclamar estos mensajes, pero para proclamarlos necesitamos comprenderlos. Al concluir la clase usted tendrá las herramientas necesarias para explicar con lujo de detalles el mensaje final de Dios para este tiempo.

programme.title: Sumtv Culto Divino
programme.desc: Bienvenido a Culto Divino, una serie de sermones semanales de SUMtv Latino con mensajes profundos y edificantes basados en la Palabra de Dios. En cada episodio de Culto Divino, se abordan temas fundamentales de la profecía bíblica, la doctrina cristiana, la verdad presente, consejos prácticos para la vida cristiana, y enseñanzas de la Biblia a través de relatos históricos. Todo esto, con el propósito de fortalecer la fe, renovar el espíritu y vivir en armonía con la voluntad de Dios.

programme.title: Anclas de la verdad
programme.desc: Serie sobre el Pentecostés y su impacto espiritual, bíblico y profé tico.

programme.title: Ancla 14: Impacto profético
programme.sub-title: La bestia que fue herida con la espada y la bestia con cuernos de cordero
programme.desc: En esta clase estudiamos las grandes profecías de Daniel y de Apocalipsis. Vamos a estudiar la profecía de Daniel 2 y 7, Apocalipsis 13:1-10, Apocalipsis 13:11-18, y Apocalipsis 17 que es una profecía un tanto difícil de interpretar pero una gran profecí a que se está cumpliendo en gran medida en nuestro días.

programme.title: Apostasía: Análisis teológico del movimiento Davidiano – Dr. Ismael Rodríguez
programme.sub-title: Un reino de gloria antes que Jesús regrese
programme.desc: esenredar una red de errores puede ser agotador y complejo. En esta serie aprenderás a discernir lo falso de lo verdadero. El movimiento Davidiano, alias, "La Vara del Pastor", ha atrapado a muchos estudiantes incautos de la Biblia que buscan la "Verdad Presente". Al concluir esta serie usted reconocerá y estará apto para refutar la mayor parte de las doctrinas davidianas, tales como Ezequiel 9, la piedra de Daniel 2, y el reino pre-milenario, así como las referencias bíblicas y del Espíritu de Profecía más usados. Usted tendrá un mayor conocimiento de la verdad al redescubrir la belleza del adventismo, prevenir el engaño y ayudar a alguien que ya está envuelto con un grupo disidente.

programme.title: Ancla 2019 – Los siete sellos de Apocalipsis
programme.desc: Serie de estudios sobre las lecciones de los siete sellos del libro de Apocalipsis.

programme.title: Cómo Vencer El Pecado
programme.sub-title: Las Terribles Consecuencias Para Quienes Persistan en el Pecado
programme.desc: Dios presenta en la Biblia que el pecado es el más grande problema en el universo; pero también revela claves que le permiten al hombre vencerlo. "Al vencedor le concederé que se siente conmigo en mi trono, así como yo he vencido y me he sentado con mi Padre en su trono." Apocalipsis 3:21.

programme.desc: Newly released from prison, Elwood Blues (Dan Aykroyd) reassembles the Blues Brothers Band with new members (John Goodman, Joe Morton).","large":"The now-brotherless Ellwood Blues (Dan Aykroyd) is finally out of prison, attempting to reunite the old band and find a few new partners in crime (John Goodman), (J. Evan Bonifant). In this sequel to the original "Blues Brothers" comedy/musical, Ellwood battles the Chicago police, sings and dances his way out of numerous sticky situations, and manages to get the old band on the road for a hair-raising adventure.

programme.title: Bird on a Wire
programme.desc: An FBI-relocated witness (Mel Gibson) and his ex-girlfriend (Goldie Hawn) from the '60s are chased by the drug thug (David Carradine) he sent to prison.","large":"Rick Jarmin (Mel Gibson) is put in witness protection after he helps the FBI bust drug dealer Eugene Sorenson (David Carradine). Fifteen years later, he is living with a new identity as a gas station attendant in Detroit. When an old flame named Marianne (Goldie Hawn) stops at the gas station and recognizes him, his cover gets blown. The recently released Sorenson finds out, and both Jarmin and Marianne have to flee across the country with the vengeful Sorenson in hot pursuit.

programme.title: Serial Mom
programme.desc: A seemingly perfect wife and mother (Kathleen Turner) from Baltimore gains celebrity status as a serial killer.

programme.title: Altered
programme.desc: Fifteen years after they were abducted by aliens, four men get a chance to take revenge when they capture one of the creatures.","large":"Forever damaged by their stint as the scientific subjects of hostile alien creatures, a trio of alien-abduction survivors -- Otis (Michael C. Williams), Duke (Brad William Henke) and Cody (Paul McCarthy-Boyington) -- troll the wooded site of their disappearance, heavily armed, in search of their attackers. After wounding a violent alien in the woods, the three drag its dying body to the home of reclusive fellow abductee Wyatt (Adam Kaufman), barricade themselves in and prepare for the worst.

programme.title: White Noise
programme.desc: An architect (Michael Keaton) believes his dead wife (Chandra West) is using electronic devices to communicate with him.","large":"Architect Jonathan Rivers (Michael Keaton) is happily married to author Anna (Chandra West), but tragedy strikes when she is killed in an accident. Deep in grief, Jonathan hears from Raymond Price (Ian McNeice), who claims that he has intercepted messages from Anna via electronic voice phenomena. Jonathan eventually comes to believe Raymond's claims, but, as he is drawn further into investigating the phenomenon, a sinister supernatural presence invades his life.

programme.title: White Noise 2: The Light
programme.desc: After nearly being killed along with his family, a man recovers and realizes that he can sense when someone is about to die.","large":"A man's family is killed, but he survives -- barely. After recovering, he realizes that he has changed in some way: He now senses when someone is about to die. In his attempts to save people who are near death, he discovers there is a price to pay for interfering with the cosmos.

programme.title: The New Daughter
programme.desc: A single father (Kevin Costner) is puzzled by his daughter's (Ivana Baquero) weird behavior, which begins soon after he moves his family to a secluded woodland home.

programme.title: Mama
programme.desc: As a woman (Jessica Chastain) tries to reintroduce her lover's (Nikolaj Coster-Waldau) traumatized nieces to a normal life, disturbing questions and occurrences suggest that a supernatural presence has followed the girls to her home.","large":"On the day that their parents die, sisters Lilly and Victoria vanish in the woods, prompting a frantic search by their Uncle Lucas (Nikolaj Coster-Waldau) and his girlfriend, Annabel (Jessica Chastain). Five years later, miraculously, the girls are found alive in a decaying cabin, and Lucas and Annabel welcome them into their home. But as Annabel tries to reintroduce the children to a normal life, she finds that someone -- or something -- still wants to tuck them in at night.

programme.title: The Unborn
programme.desc: With the help of a spiritualist (Gary Oldman), a woman (Odette Yustman) uncovers a family curse dating back to Nazi Germany and involving a demonic spirit with the power to inhabit anything or anyone.","large":"Plagued by nightmares and visitations from tortured ghosts, Casey Beldon turns to a spiritual adviser named Sendak for help. They discover a family curse that dates back to Nazi Germany: an evil spirit that can take over the body of anyone and is getting stronger with each possession, as it tries to gain full entrance to this world.

programme.title: The Forest
programme.desc: While investigating the disappearance of her twin sister, a young American encounters the tormented spirits of Japan's mysterious and legendary Aokigahara Forest.","large":"When her twin sister disappears in Japan, a young American named Sara becomes determined to find out what happened to her. Sara's investigation leads her to the legendary Aokigahara Forest, located at the base of Mount Fuji. Accompanied by expatriate Aiden, she enters the mysterious wilderness after being warned to "stay on the path." Her investigation plunges her into a dark world where the angry and tormented souls of the dead prey on those who dare to explore the forest.

programme.title: Dead Silence
programme.desc: After his wife meets a grisly end, a man (Ryan Kwanten) returns to their haunted hometown and uncovers a supernatural link to her death.","large":"After his wife meets a grisly end, Jamie Ashen (Ryan Kwanten) returns to their creepy hometown of Ravens Fair to unravel the mystery of her murder. Once there, he discovers the legend of Mary Shaw (Joan Heney), a murdered ventriloquist whose eerie presence still looms over the town. As he desperately digs for answers, Jamie encounters the curse that took his wife's life and threatens his own.

programme.title: Unfriended
programme.desc: A teenager (Shelley Hennig) and her five friends (Moses Storm, Renee Olstead) become the prey of an unknown online presence that wants revenge for a shaming video that caused a classmate to kill herself one year prior.","large":"One night, while teenagers Blaire, Mitch, Jess, Adam Ken and Val take part in an online group chat session, they are suddenly joined by a user known only as "Billie227." Thinking it's just a technical glitch, the friends carry on their conversation... until Blaire begins receiving messages from someone claiming to be Laura Barns, a classmate who killed herself exactly one year prior. As Blaire tries to expose Billie's identity, her friends are forced to confront their darkest secrets and lies.

programme.title: Black Christmas
programme.desc: As sorority sisters prepare for holiday parties, a mysterious cloaked figure starts to leave a bloody trail throughout their campus. Refusing to become victims, the girls decide to band together and fight back against the psychotic Christmas killer.","large":"Hawthorne College is quieting down for the holidays as students travel home to spend time with their families. But as Riley and her sorority sisters prepare to deck the halls with seasonal parties, a mysterious cloaked figure starts to leave a bloody trail throughout the campus. Refusing to become hapless victims, Riley and her friends decide to band together and fight back against the psychotic Christmas killer.

programme.title: Nocturnal Animals
programme.desc: A writer (Jake Gyllenhaal) asks his ex-wife (Amy Adams) to read a manuscript of his new novel, a troubling story about a family man whose life takes a dark turn.","large":"A successful Los Angeles art-gallery owner's idyllic life is marred by the constant traveling of her handsome second husband. While he is away, she is shaken by the arrival of a manuscript written by her first husband, who she has not seen in years. The manuscript tells the story of a teacher who finds a trip with his family turning into a nightmare. As Susan reads the book, it forces her to examine her past and confront some dark truths.

programme.title: Land of the Dead
programme.desc: A mercenary leader (Simon Baker) squares off with a rebellious comrade (John Leguizamo), while flesh-eating zombies threaten their fortified city.","large":"In a world where zombies form the majority of the population, the remaining humans build a feudal society away from the undead. Ruthless Paul Kaufman (Dennis Hopper) rules and protects this microcosm but enforces painful class distinctions. Second-in-command Cholo DeMora (John Leguizamo) attempts to lead a secret rebellion against Kaufman's tyranny, but when the zombies begin to evolve, the survivors must discover a way to protect themselves from a zombie horde that can learn and adapt.

Williams), Duke (Brad William Henke) and Cody (Paul McCarthy-Boyington) -- troll the wooded site of their disappearance, heavily armed, in search of their attackers.
