programme.title: Walk of Shame
programme.desc: A woman's dream of becoming a news anchor is jeopardized by an ill-advised tryst that leaves her stranded in downtown Los Angeles with no money or transportation and only eight hours to make it to the most important job interview of her life.","large":"Meghan (Elizabeth Banks) is an aspiring news anchor in the cutthroat world of Los Angeles television. After an audition for her dream job ends in failure, she goes out for an uncharacteristic night of partying. The next morning, she awakes in a stranger's bed and hears a phone message from her agent telling her the job is hers if she can make it across town by 5:00 pm. Stranded in an unknown area without money, phone or transportation, she races to the most important interview of her life.

programme.title: Trainwreck
programme.desc: A promiscuous magazine writer considers monogamy for the first time when she starts to fall in love with the charming sports doctor she's profiling.","large":"Ever since her father drilled into her head that monogamy isn't realistic, magazine writer Amy has made promiscuity her credo. As much as she enjoys an uninhibited life free of commitment, Amy is really in a rut. While writing a profile about charming and successful sports doctor Aaron Conners, she finds herself actually falling in love for the first time, and what's more, Aaron seems to like her too. Amy starts to wonder if it's time to clean up her act.

programme.title: The Break-Up
programme.desc: Former lovers (Vince Vaughn, Jennifer Aniston) live together as hostile roommates when both refuse to move out of their shared condominium.","large":"When Brooke (Jennifer Aniston), an art dealer, and Gary (Vince Vaughn), a tour-bus driver, finally call it quits in their relationship, neither is willing to move out of their shared condo. With their friends suggesting a series of underhanded tactics that fail to get either Brooke or Gary to cave in, the only solution is to become hostile roommates.

programme.title: Chinese Zodiac
programme.desc: A treasure hunter (Jackie Chan) and his team set out on a global quest to find a set of Chinese zodiac bronze heads that were stolen from a Beijing palace in the 19th century.

programme.title: Trespass
programme.desc: Two Arkansas firefighters (Bill Paxton, William Sadler) have a shootout over gold with a crime lord's (Ice-T) gang in a factory.","large":"Firefighters Vince (Bill Paxton) and Don (William Sadler) venture into gang-infested territory to find gold that's been hidden inside an abandoned building. But when they witness a murder, they become the targets of crime lord King James (Ice-T) and his underling Savon (Ice Cube). Fortunately, the treasure hunters have kidnapped a bargaining chip: King James' half-brother, Lucky (Devoreaux White). But this might not be enough to get them -- and their gold -- out of the building intact.

programme.title: Smokin' Aces
programme.desc: Two FBI agents (Ray Liotta, Ryan Reynolds) must protect an entertainer (Jeremy Piven) from a motley crew of assassins after the guy agrees to testify against the Las Vegas mob.","large":"Sleazy entertainer Buddy "Aces" Israel incurs the wrath of crime boss Primo Sparazza when he agrees to testify against the Las Vegas mob. Two FBI agents have the difficult task of protecting him from a motley assortment of bounty hunters, hit men and nefarious vixens who are converging on his Lake Tahoe encampment to rub him out and collect a hefty reward.

programme.title: They Live
programme.desc: When two men (Roddy Piper, Keith David) put on special sunglasses they see aliens and subliminal messages.","large":"Nada (Roddy Piper), a wanderer without meaning in his life, discovers a pair of sunglasses capable of showing the world the way it truly is. As he walks the streets of Los Angeles, Nada notices that both the media and the government are comprised of subliminal messages meant to keep the population subdued, and that most of the social elite are skull-faced aliens bent on world domination. With this shocking discovery, Nada fights to free humanity from the mind-controlling aliens.

programme.title: The Watcher
programme.desc: A traumatized FBI agent (James Spader) comes out of hiding to catch a serial killer (Keanu Reeves) who sends him pictures of his intended victims before he strikes.","large":"The Watcher is an exciting psychological thriller that takes a unique look into the minds of both a serial killer and the man who must, reluctantly, pursue him. In an almost Hitchcockian way, the film quickly introduces us to the killer, David Allen Griffin, played by Keanu Reeves, who for many years, preyed on lonely young women in the Los Angeles area. The story is set up to create a taut cat-and-mouse game between Griffin and FBI agent Joel Campbell.

programme.title: Captive State
programme.desc: Gabriel is a young man who joins a resistance group that's fighting back against extraterrestrial occupation of Chicago. He soon finds himself under careful scrutiny from a shadowy figure who's trying to crush the rebellion and its plans for freedom.","large":"After 10 years of extraterrestrial occupation, residents of Chicago must decide whether to continue to live under alien rule or support the resistance. When young Gabriel Drummond joins the insurgency, he soon finds himself under careful scrutiny from a shadowy figure who's trying to crush the rebellion and its plans for freedom.

programme.title: The Fourth Kind
programme.desc: During videotaped sessions with her patients, a psychologist (Milla Jovovich) in Alaska uncovers disturbing evidence of alien abductions.","large":"Since the 1960s, a disproportionate number of the population in and around Nome, Alaska, have gone missing. Despite FBI investigations, the disappearances remain a mystery. Dr. Abigail Tyler (Milla Jovovich), a psychologist, may be on the verge of blowing the unsolved cases wide open when, during the course of treating her patients, she finds evidence of alien abductions.

programme.title: Lone Survivor
programme.desc: In the mountains of Afghanistan, a squad of Taliban fighters ambushes four Navy SEALs, who are there on a mission to eliminate a high-ranking al-Qaeda operative.","large":"In 2005 Afghanistan, Navy SEALs Marcus Luttrell (Mark Wahlberg), Michael Murphy (Taylor Kitsch), Danny Dietz (Emile Hirsch) and Matthew "Axe" Axelson (Ben Foster) deploy on a mission of surveillance and to take out Taliban leader Ahmad Shah. Though spotted by goatherds, Luttrell and his team decide not to kill them. But one of the Afghans alerts a group of Taliban fighters to the invaders, and a terrible battle ensues, in which the SEALs find themselves hopelessly outnumbered and outgunned.

programme.title: Jarhead 2: Field of Fire
programme.desc: Without tanks or air support, a corporal and his team must muster all the courage and firepower they can to fight their way across war-torn Afghanistan and shepherd an important anti-Taliban woman to safety.

programme.title: American Pie
programme.desc: Four teenage boys enter a pact to lose their virginity by prom night.

programme.title: American Pie 2
programme.desc: Old friends gather after their freshman year in college to rent a summerhouse on Lake Michigan and chase girls.","large":"After a year apart - attending different schools, meeting different people - the guys rent a beach house and vow to make this the best summer ever. As it turns out, whether that will happen or not has a lot to do with the girls. Between the wild parties, outrageous revelations and yes, a trip to band camp, they discover that times change and people change, but in the end, it's all about sticking together.

programme.title: Accepted
programme.desc: After trying and failing to get into college, a high-school senior (Justin Long) and his friends fool parents and peers by creating their own university.","large":"After receiving his latest college rejection letter, senior Bartleby Gaines devises a novel way to fool everyone into thinking he is college-bound: Open his own university. Bartleby and his similarly stymied friends take over an abandoned building, create a fake website, hire a friend's uncle to pose as the dean, and -- presto -- a school is born. However, they do their jobs too well, and soon many other rejects try to gain admittance to the nonexistent South Harmon Institute of Technology.

After a carjacking puts Junior in the hands of a vicious criminal leader, O2 turns to street-smart hustler Coco (Meagan Good) for help. programme.title: Alpha Dog
programme.desc: A teenage dealer (Emile Hirsch) and his friends kidnap the impressionable younger brother of a junkie who won't pay for the drugs.","large":"Teenage dealer Johnny Truelove (Emile Hirsch) and his friends kidnap the impressionable younger brother (Anton Yelchin) of a junkie (Ben Foster) who refuses to pay his drug debt. programme.desc: Mysterious murders occur when students (Lindy Booth, Julian Morris) at a prep school invent a story about a serial killer.

programme.title: Psycho

programme.desc: Former gang members return to depressed Gary, Ind., to quell violence perpetrated by their successors.","large":"Successful Los Angeles football coach John Bookman returns home to Gary, IN, when his father is murdered. John teams up with Jake and Laurie, the parents of a boy who was also killed by a Rebel, to organize their neighborhood against gang violence.

Beans now struggles to maintain his family life, while bumping heads with opposing gangsters and the police. It all comes to a head when he cannot surpass the city's most notorious crew run by Untouchable J (Jay-Z) and Dame (Damon Dash).

programme.desc: After recovering from a terrible accident where his '32 Ford caught fire, a local business owner wants to see the car fixed as well; diagnosing the fire damage and what caused it is a priority; a 1967 Mustang arrives with a nasty engine vibration.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Dave designs a Mustang for the ages to compete in the Optima Challenge; the build includes a new front fascia and hood and redesigning the rear end.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: The 1965 Mustang makes its way through the metal shop and is now ready for paint and final assembly; making it function will test even the Kindig crew.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Dave has decided that the time is right to design his own concept car from scratch; it's a huge job that involves all the different departments in the shop.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: All the Concept Corvette's elements are built and assembled, but Dave needs to find a buyer; a rock 'n' roll icon brings his '34 Ford coupe to the shop.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.sub-title: Just a Couple Heres and Theres
programme.desc: A simple repaint of a 1964 Corvette careens into much more after Dave upsells the client on a couple of design features, and the crew finds some damage underneath the original paint; the owner of an iconic Ford GTX1 tasks Dave with solving a dilemma.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: An abandoned 1967 C10 that has been sitting for years has been sold to a client who wants a few new touches, but closer inspection reveals more work is needed.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Dave convinces the client to make the 1967 C10 truck into a convertible; Kevin takes on a new personal project with a Cadillac Escalade.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: The engineering on the convertible C10 works in theory, but making it work in practice is the next step; a team brings in a replica 1967 Cobra with a bad engine.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Of all the different years and generations of the VW Bug, there is one that stands out among the rest -- the Hebmüller; there are maybe 200 of them left, so in addition to being hard to find, they are truly the holy grail of VWs.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: The build continues, and the challenge is to keep what makes the car a Hebmueller intact, while taking steps to turn it into a hot rod; Dave keeps the traditional two-tone exterior, but modifying it to an automatic is a challenge for the shop.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Normally when Kindig-It Design attends a car show, their cars are the ones being judged; this time around, Dave and Kev hold the keys and have to select the top 10 builders out of the hundreds of cars that arrive for the show.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Dave's clients have owned a car since they got married 25 years ago and want it restored so they can enjoy it for another 25; while the shop isn't really into straight restorations, adding some custom pieces and paint makes them say yes to the pro.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.sub-title: It's a Barn Door Deluxe, Of Course
programme.desc: Dave is thrilled with the latest build, while KevDogg is barely lukewarm; Dave has done double-cab VWs, Bugs and Karmann Ghias, but now he is taking on something completely different, and even more rare.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Matching the two-tone paint job is the challenge of the day as the '53 Barn Door Deluxe build carries on; custom trim, a new, more powerful engine, 22 windows and a custom interior all come together to make this surprise worth the wait.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Dave and the guys at Kindig-It proved they could execute Dave's vision of his production Corvette, but now that a few have sold, they have to get them completely finished.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Dave and the team put the finishing touches on the first-ever Kindig CF Corvettes to complete a lifelong dream; however, the clients argue about who will get the first one, all in advance of a once-in-a-lifetime debut at SEMA.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Dave and Kevin, who have been an absolute treat for automotive enthusiasts for years, come back to the SEMA show with something special on their minds.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: A Beatles fanatic challenges Dave to paint a modern Rolls-Royce to match the car John Lennon commissioned in the late 1960s.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Dave and Kev take the show as far east as they have ever gone and head to Lake George, New York, for the Adirondack Nationals; the town shuts down for the car show, attracting some of the best on the east coast.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: A 1970s Pantera is an iconic sports car, but once Dave gets his hands on it, the style will never be the same; the client has given Dave free rein to change the car as he sees fit, but has one request: he is 6'4" and can't comfortably get in it.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: With the whole team in agreement over the body mods, the crew must make the designs into reality; their list of tasks include bulging out the fenders, creating a spider-shaped exhaust, executing the stretch and getting the car to body.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.sub-title: Now That Is a Bitchin' Ride
programme.desc: The Pantera is almost done, but nothing is simple with this car; Dave and Kev get a chance to upgrade their semi rig.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: Carb whisperer Steve Brule has tips to get a Holley 4150 running its best.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: Dulcich tests four aftermarket intake manifolds on his 225ci slant six.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: The guys test which type of cylinder head delivers more power.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.sub-title: The Battle of Gen III Hemis
programme.desc: We're battling the two most recent iterations of the 5.7 III Hemi.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: The Windsor family finally gets its turn at an intake shootout!

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: The guys debate if a solid roller camshaft is worth the extra money.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: We run our LS with factory exhaust manifolds and again with turbo headers.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: The guys deliberately heat and cool fuel to see the difference it makes.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: The guys find out if Max Wedge heads are really a worthwhile upgrade.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: We find out whether header wraps really do create more power.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: The guys test out a bunch of Holley's "Ram" intakes on their 6.2-liter LS.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: We test six manifolds with our old-school carb and our new-school 6.0 LS.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: The guys see if exhaust cutouts do more than rattle passersby's eardrums.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: The crew super-tunes every HP out of the 410 Windsor from the Disgustang.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: The guys test out three low-buck cylinder heads on a 383 small-block Chevy.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: The guys test how different carb features affect horsepower and tunability.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: The guys challenge their previous findings testing single-pattern cams.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: The guys see if too much oil pressure robs precious horsepower.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: The guys try to boost an 800-horspower 572 up to a comfortable 950+.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: The guys shoot out six packs on a 440 to see which makes the most power.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.sub-title: Magic of the Flex Fuel Sensor
programme.desc: The guys figure out how to make more power with a flex fuel engine.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: The guys see whether boost and vacuum leaks actually affect power.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: The guys see how wet and dry nitrous systems stack up on an EFI manifold.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: Multipoint EFI gets its turn against the venerable Dominator.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: A supercharged medium-sized mill takes on a naturally aspirated big block.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: The crew pits a four-barrel carb against dual quads on the tunnel ram.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.sub-title: How Hard Can a Hardtop Be?
programme.desc: A 1971 Chevy Nova with tremendous pedigree arrives at the shop to get classic Kindig-It styling cues; Dave wants to make this car into a hardtop; tucked-in bumpers, front valance and a new engine provide a good test for the crew.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Will makes miracles happen, and Dave decides to make a wholesale change to the car's color; challenges mount at each stage of the build, and the upholstery shop changes up their routine as the client arrives for a reveal years in the making.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: While the shop perfects its process in building the CF1s, word about the car spreads and potential buyers line up; the latest client has a big problem when he can't choose the perfect color combination.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Dave and Kev take the show to the Midwest, as more than 2,500 cars descend on the Summit Motorsports drag strip for a weekend of fun; Kev gets a ride in a lean, mean drag racing machine; Dave steps up his autocross game.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: A client enlists Dave on a mission from God to make his dreams of a father/son road trip along Route 66 come true; getting the client's mechanically unsound reproduction of the Bluesmobile ready for the road will test the crew's mettle.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Kevin Schiele breathes new life into a semi-hauler by giving it a visual and functional upgrade that impeccably reflects his expertise in trucks.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Training the next-generation car builders is near and dear to Dave's heart, and after years of planning, he's finally realized his passion project, the Kindig Academy.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.sub-title: Is There Anything Good on It?
programme.desc: A 1969 Camaro comes in; when Dave and team get a closer look, they determine with the owner that it requires a full rebuild; since the team will be starting from scratch, the client decides to go all-out on the chassis, engine and details.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: With the Camaro's design firmed up, the build continues, but hits a roadblock when it comes to getting the engine dialed in just right; Dave has second thoughts about the color combination.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.sub-title: There's a Bolt in My Motor
programme.desc: A simple engine repair slowly turns into a patented Kindig slippery slope, as a show-ready 1935 Roadster V8 requires a full rebuild.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: The shop hits the road to check out the competition; Will and Dave's cousin Brad comes along for the ride to share their view on the cars they come across; they team up to challenge Dave in an autocross.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: The 1955 Nomad is an iconic car, but the original power isn't enough for the current owner, who wants the guys to put a blower on to boost the power; a new project for a secret client arrives in pretty rough shape, but emerges ready to rumble.

programme.desc: A team of space marines known as the Rapid Response Tactical Squad, led by Sarge (Karl Urban), is sent to a science facility on Mars after somebody reports a security breach. programme.title: Quarta Repubblica
programme.desc: Alla scoperta dei più importanti temi di attualità, politica ed economia. Un'analisi approfondita dei maggiori eventi che interessano il Paese affrontati in compagnia di importanti ospiti in studio.

programme.title: 4 di sera
programme.desc: Uno spazio informativo in cui discutere degli avvenimenti che segnano l'agenda quotidiana, con gli aggiornamenti e le notizie più importanti in materia di cronaca, politica, cultura, società e sport.

programme.title: Caduta libera
programme.desc: Un concorrente al centro dello studio, sopra una botola, rischia di cadere alla prima risposta sbagliata. A sfidarlo, dieci avversari pronti a incorrere nella stessa sorte in un duello a suon di domande.

programme.title: Cazatalentos
programme.desc: Un impresario parigino ritrova fiducia in sé stesso e nell'arte promuovendo una ballerina in fuga dalla guerra civile spagnola.

programme.title: Tira e molla
programme.desc: Show ideato da Corrado Mantoni. Due coppie di concorrenti si sfidano in 4 prove per accumulare il montepremi più alto. Ma nell'ultimo gioco la situazione si può completamente capovolgere.

programme.title: Sport Mediaset
programme.desc: Telegiornale sportivo: novità, anticipazioni, collegamenti in diretta e servizi in esclusiva. Il programma erede di 'Studio Sport' continua a portare nelle case degli italiani le più aggiornate e complete informazioni sul mondo dell'agonismo.

programme.title: Tg4: Diario del giorno
programme.desc: Le principali notizie del momento a cura della redazione della rete. Aggiornamenti e approfondimenti riguardanti politica, cronaca, esteri, economia, sport e attualità.

programme.title: 4 di sera
programme.desc: Uno spazio informativo in cui discutere degli avvenimenti che segnano l'agenda quotidiana, con gli aggiornamenti e le notizie più importanti in materia di cronaca, politica, cultura, società e sport.

programme.title: Forum
programme.desc: Il processo tv che affronta vicende comuni e quotidiane con uno sguardo sempre attento ai temi più attuali. Spazio anche per il confronto dedicato alle cause più complesse, in un dialogo tra generazioni diverse.

programme.title: Lo sportello di Forum
programme.desc: La sessione pomeridiana del tribunale televisivo di Forum: due cittadini affidano la soluzione delle proprie dispute e dei propri contenziosi affidandosi ad un giudice e alla legge dello stato.

programme.title: Beautiful
programme.desc: Finn ha detto a Steffy che il figlio che aspetta è suo e non di Liam. Steffy ha accettato di sposarlo e gli chiede spiegazioni su quanto è avvenuto; soprattutto è preoccupata che Thomas abbia commesso delle scorrettezze, ma Finn la rassicura.

programme.title: Grande fratello VIP: Live
programme.desc: In diretta dalla casa di Cinecittà, le telecamere seguono gli inquilini protagonisti della nuova edizione de 'Il grande fratello VIP', impegnati nell'accattivarsi le simpatie del pubblico.

programme.title: Uomini e donne
programme.desc: Uomini e donne si incontrano e si corteggiano alla ricerca dell'anima gemella. Il pubblico in studio è chiamato a partecipare alle vicende amorose dei concorrenti con commenti e consigli.

programme.title: Caduta libera

programme.title: Sport Mediaset Extra
programme.desc: Segui le ultime novità dal mondo dello sport.

programme.title: Ore 11
programme.desc: Il nuovo programma incentrato sull'attualità e sulla cronaca, condotto da Milo Infante.

programme.title: Miniatur Wunderland XXL
programme.desc: Während Gondelspezialist Felix seine filigranen Meisterwerke "zu Wasser" lässt, kämpfen die Mitarbeiter des Carsystems mit der Bewältigung des Alltags. Denn die Autos im Miniatur Wunderland sind genauso reparaturanfällig wie im realen Leben.

programme.title: Countdown zum Großen Beben
programme.desc: Da Erdbeben meist ohne Vorwarnung verheerende Schäden anrichten, suchen Wissenschaftler mit modernster Technologie nach besseren Vorhersagemethoden. Bisherige Instrumente sind jedoch noch zu unzuverlässig für präzise Prognosen.

programme.title: Die Erdbeben-Jäger
programme.desc: In Europa kam es in der Vergangenheit bereits zu verheerenden Erdbeben. Zwar ist der alte Kontinent nicht als Hauptrisikogebiet für extreme Beben bekannt, doch die unsichtbare Gefahr aus der Tiefe bleibt für Millionen Menschen eine reale Bedrohung.

programme.title: Re:
programme.sub-title: Leben mit der Lava auf Island
programme.desc: Seit Monaten reißt im Süden Islands immer wieder die Erde auf und glühende Lavaströme bedrohen die Hafenstadt Grindavík. Die meisten Bewohner haben die Stadt verlassen. Doch einige Grindavíker kehren zurück, sobald die Lava erkaltet ist.

programme.title: Hawai'i: Aus Feuer geboren
programme.desc: Kaua'i ist die älteste Insel des Archipels. Die Tausende Jahre andauernde Isolation Kaua'is führte zu einer erhöhten Evolutionsrate: In relativ kurzer Zeit bildeten sich auf der Insel neue Arten, viele Tiere und Pflanzen. Doch sie sind in Gefahr.

programme.title: Hawai'i: Aus Feuer geboren
programme.desc: In dieser Folge der Dokumentationsreihe wird ein Blick auf Maui und Moloka'i geworfen. In der Mitte des Archipels bilden sie das Herz Hawaiis. Die zweitgrößte Insel Hawaiis - Maui - ist ein wahres Paradies für Surfer.

programme.title: Ärzte ohne Grenzen - Dem Leben verschrieben
programme.desc: Das Flüchtlingslager Domiz im kurdischen Nordirak: Jeden Tag kommen hunderte neue Bürgerkriegsflüchtlinge aus Syrien hier an. Über 35.000 Menschen haben in dem Lager in überfüllten Verschlägen und Zelten eine vorübergehende Bleibe gefunden. Nur wenige Hilfsorganisationen sind hier tätig. Es fehlt an allem.

programme.title: Ärzte ohne Grenzen - Dem Leben verschrieben
programme.desc: Seit drei Monaten arbeitet Bernhard als medizinischer Leiter am Projekt. Seine Aufgabe ist, die Bevölkerung der Provinz Boquerón auf Chagas zu testen und bereits infizierte Personen entsprechend zu behandeln, da die vorhandene Medizin veraltet ist.

programme.title: Ärzte ohne Grenzen - Dem Leben verschrieben
programme.desc: Zahlreiche Ärzte bereisen den Globus und wagen sich dabei in Krisenregionen, wo Hunger, Krieg und Krankheiten wüten. Sie lassen für ihre Einsätze den geregelten Alltag hinter sich, um zahlreiche Menschenleben zu retten.

programme.title: Ärzte ohne Grenzen - Dem Leben verschrieben
programme.desc: Im Kongo testet Ilka die Kinder an der Schule auf die Schlafkrankheit. Trotz Tränen lassen die Kinder den Test über sich ergehen. Sobald der Einsatz beendet ist, verabschiedet sich Ilka schweren Herzens von ihren Kollegen.

programme.title: Re:
programme.desc: Etwa 1,8 Millionen Menschen in Deutschland sind tablettenabhängig, mehr als von Alkohol. Meist wird das Leiden erst spät erkannt. Schnell steigen der Suchtdruck und die Dosis. Wie ergeht es Betroffenen, und welche Wege gibt es aus dem Teufelskreis?

programme.title: Re:
programme.sub-title: ADHS bei Erwachsenen - Hummeln im Hirn
programme.desc: ADHS galt lange als Krankheit von Kindern und Jugendlichen. Doch sie kann auch Erwachsene betreffen, wenn sie nicht früh erkannt wird und unbehandelt bleibt. Knapp fünf Prozent der Erwachsenen haben ADHS - und wissen es oft nicht.

programme.title: Re:
programme.desc: Sogenannte Abnehmspritzen versprechen, mühelos Gewicht zu verlieren - ohne Diät. Ursprünglich zur Behandlung von Diabetes entwickelte Wirkstoffe zügeln den Appetit. Doch das Abnehmen mit der Spritze ist teuer und hat häufig Nebenwirkungen.

programme.title: Deutschland auf dem Öko-Trip
programme.desc: Den Kampf gegen sexistische Strukturen gibt es schon lang. Früher war es vorwiegend ein Konflikt zwischen Mann und Frau. Heute schalten sich in die Gender-Debatte Lesben, Schwulen, Trans- und Bisexuellen, sowie andere sexuelle Orientierungen ein.

programme.title: Brain-Computer-Interface: Das digitale Gehirn
programme.desc: Die revolutionäre Verschmelzung von Gehirn und Computer eröffnet der Medizin völlig neue Welten, birgt aber auch immense ethische Gefahren. Visionäre Technologien erlauben die direkte Steuerung von Maschinen allein durch menschliche Gedankenkraft.

programme.title: Geheimnisse des Gehirns
programme.desc: Dr. Jack Lewis trifft auf einen Mann, der aus dem Koma erwachte und nur noch log. Er dachte sich Geschichten aus.

programme.title: Stephen Hawking: Reise durchs All
programme.desc: Das Universum ist scheinbar unendlich groß und fordert den unstillbaren Wissensdurst des Physikers Stephen Hawking heraus. Der Wissenschaftler begibt sich ein letztes Mal auf eine Reise zu den wichtigsten Stationen seiner Karriere und in den Kosmos.

programme.title: Stephen Hawking: Reise durchs All
programme.desc: In dieser Episode reist Stephen Hawking zur Venus, zur Sonne und bis hin zum mysteriösen Adlernebel. Dabei versucht er noch immer, die Weltformel zu finden, doch auf seinem Flug durch das Weltall verläuft nicht alles nach Plan.

programme.title: Stephen Hawking: Reise durchs All
programme.desc: Stephen Hawking setzt seine Suche nach der Weltformel fort. Er lernt dabei eine außerirdische KI kennen und landet mit seinem Raumschiff auf einer alternativen Erde. Außerdem stellt er sich die Frage, ob das Universum nicht ein Multiversum ist.

programme.title: Vorbild Natur
programme.desc: Für einige Menschen sind Insekten nur lästige Krabbeltiere. Doch für viele Forscher sind sie kleine Genies, die dabei helfen können, einige der größten Probleme zu lösen. Die Sendung widmet sich den Vorbildern Ameise, Kartoffelkäfer und Marienkäfer.

programme.title: 42 - Die Antwort auf fast alles
programme.desc: Ohne Zweifel hat Hass eine zerstörerische Kraft. Hass ist zielgerichtet und destruktiv. Aber hat der Hass eigentlich auch einen Sinn? Warum hassen Menschen überhaupt? Viele Fragen, und die Wissenschaft hat längst noch nicht alle beantwortet.

programme.title: 42 - Die Antwort auf fast alles
programme.desc: Wissenschaftler aus den Bereichen Quantenphysik, Stringtheorie und Astrophysik machen deutlich, dass eine Zeitreise theoretisch möglich ist - zumindest, wenn es in die Zukunft gehen soll. Es wird beleuchtet, was die Voraussetzungen dafür sind.

programme.title: 42 - Die Antwort auf fast alles
programme.desc: Pilze sind kaum erforscht. Dabei gehören sie zu den ältesten und vielfältigsten Lebensformen des Planeten. Erst durch Pilze konnten sich vor Urzeiten Pflanzen entwickeln. Sie sind überall zu Hause: in der Erde, in der Luft und in Körpern.

programme.title: 42 - Die Antwort auf fast alles
programme.desc: Ein Leben ohne Farben ist kaum vorstellbar, weder für uns Menschen noch für zahlreiche Tier- und Pflanzenarten. Der Film erklärt, woher die Macht der Farben kommt und wie man es schafft, sie am besten zu nutzen.

programme.title: Mind Matters - Die 5 größten Geheimnisse deines Gehirns
programme.desc: Wir begeben uns auf eine Reise in das menschliche Gehirn, die fünf zentrale Erkenntnisse enthüllt.

programme.title: Body Code - Die 5 größten Geheimnisse deines Körpers

programme.title: Tierisch gute Augen
programme.desc: Professor Thomas Cronin erklärt, wie Tiere die Welt visuell wahrnehmen. Außerdem geht es darum, wie das, was sie sehen, den Platz der Tiere in der Natur beeinflusst und wie ihr Platz in der Natur beeinflusst, was sie sehen.

programme.title: Tierisch gute Augen
programme.desc: Professor Thomas Cronin erklärt, wie Tiere die Welt visuell wahrnehmen. Außerdem geht es darum, wie das, was sie sehen, den Platz der Tiere in der Natur beeinflusst und wie ihr Platz in der Natur beeinflusst, was sie sehen.

programme.title: Rückkehr zum Mond
programme.desc: Die Apollo-Ausrüstung ist seit mehr als 40 Jahren auf dem Mond zurückgelassen worden. Jetzt gibt es einen neuen Drang und Bemühungen, zum Mond zurückzukehren. Diesmal nicht, um eine Flagge aufzustellen, sondern um ihn zu kolonisieren.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Der Mond - Unser Tor Ins All
programme.desc: Der Mond löst seit jeher Faszination aus. USA und UdSSR lieferten sich einen Wettstreit um die Erforschung. Die Sendung zeigt, welche überraschenden Erkenntnisse die Forschung seither gewonnen hat und ob der Traum einer Mondstation realistisch ist.

programme.title: Reise zur Sonne
programme.desc: Das Video berichtet vom Flug der NASA-Raumsonde "Parker Solar Probe" zur Sonne.

programme.title: Deutschland auf dem Öko-Trip
programme.desc: Den Kampf gegen sexistische Strukturen gibt es schon lang. Früher war es vorwiegend ein Konflikt zwischen Mann und Frau. Heute schalten sich in die Gender-Debatte Lesben, Schwulen, Trans- und Bisexuellen, sowie andere sexuelle Orientierungen ein.

programme.title: Brain-Computer-Interface: Das digitale Gehirn
programme.desc: Die revolutionäre Verschmelzung von Gehirn und Computer eröffnet der Medizin völlig neue Welten, birgt aber auch immense ethische Gefahren. Visionäre Technologien erlauben die direkte Steuerung von Maschinen allein durch menschliche Gedankenkraft.

programme.title: Geheimnisse des Gehirns
programme.desc: Dr. Jack Lewis trifft auf einen Mann, der aus dem Koma erwachte und nur noch log. Er dachte sich Geschichten aus.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Stephen Hawking: Reise durchs All
programme.desc: Das Universum ist scheinbar unendlich groß und fordert den unstillbaren Wissensdurst des Physikers Stephen Hawking heraus. Der Wissenschaftler begibt sich ein letztes Mal auf eine Reise zu den wichtigsten Stationen seiner Karriere und in den Kosmos.

programme.title: Stephen Hawking: Reise durchs All
programme.desc: In dieser Episode reist Stephen Hawking zur Venus, zur Sonne und bis hin zum mysteriösen Adlernebel. Dabei versucht er noch immer, die Weltformel zu finden, doch auf seinem Flug durch das Weltall verläuft nicht alles nach Plan.

programme.title: Stephen Hawking: Reise durchs All
programme.desc: Stephen Hawking setzt seine Suche nach der Weltformel fort. Er lernt dabei eine außerirdische KI kennen und landet mit seinem Raumschiff auf einer alternativen Erde. Außerdem stellt er sich die Frage, ob das Universum nicht ein Multiversum ist.

programme.title: Vorbild Natur
programme.desc: Für einige Menschen sind Insekten nur lästige Krabbeltiere. Doch für viele Forscher sind sie kleine Genies, die dabei helfen können, einige der größten Probleme zu lösen. Die Sendung widmet sich den Vorbildern Ameise, Kartoffelkäfer und Marienkäfer.

programme.title: 42 - Die Antwort auf fast alles
programme.desc: Ohne Zweifel hat Hass eine zerstörerische Kraft. Hass ist zielgerichtet und destruktiv. Aber hat der Hass eigentlich auch einen Sinn? Warum hassen Menschen überhaupt? Viele Fragen, und die Wissenschaft hat längst noch nicht alle beantwortet.

programme.title: 42 - Die Antwort auf fast alles
programme.desc: Wissenschaftler aus den Bereichen Quantenphysik, Stringtheorie und Astrophysik machen deutlich, dass eine Zeitreise theoretisch möglich ist - zumindest, wenn es in die Zukunft gehen soll. Es wird beleuchtet, was die Voraussetzungen dafür sind.

programme.title: 42 - Die Antwort auf fast alles
programme.desc: Pilze sind kaum erforscht. Dabei gehören sie zu den ältesten und vielfältigsten Lebensformen des Planeten. Erst durch Pilze konnten sich vor Urzeiten Pflanzen entwickeln. Sie sind überall zu Hause: in der Erde, in der Luft und in Körpern.

programme.title: 42 - Die Antwort auf fast alles
programme.desc: Ein Leben ohne Farben ist kaum vorstellbar, weder für uns Menschen noch für zahlreiche Tier- und Pflanzenarten. Der Film erklärt, woher die Macht der Farben kommt und wie man es schafft, sie am besten zu nutzen.

programme.title: Penny auf der Reeperbahn
programme.desc: Die Penny-Filiale auf der Reeperbahn ist der wohl berühmteste Supermarkt Deutschlands und ist Lebensmittelgeschäft und Party Location zugleich. Wenn die Bars und Clubs der Meile schließen, wird der Discounter zum Meeting Point der Szenegänger.

programme.title: Penny auf der Reeperbahn
programme.desc: Für einen Supermarkt inmitten der Reeperbahn ist Chaos vorprogrammiert. So wird einem Stofftier Schnaps in den Mund gekippt und an der Kassenschlange werden Frauen in die Luft gehoben. Da wird dem ein oder anderen auch mal Hausverbot erteilt.

programme.title: Die Pennymarkt-Promis vom Kiez
programme.desc: Der Penny-Markt auf der Reeperbahn wird auch von Prominenten und schrill-schillernden Kunden besucht. Eine von ihnen ist die Künstlerin Christine Licht, die vor 17 Jahren durch ihre Tanzkünste vor dem Obst- und Gemüseregal schlagartig bekannt wurde.

programme.title: Ich kauf mir ein Schloss
programme.desc: Die Dokumentation stellt Menschen vor, die ihren Traum vom Leben in einem der vielen Schlösser in Europa verwirklichen. Der Kaufpreis ist oft ein Schnäppchen. Doch die "Schlossrettung" wird zur Lebensaufgabe mit vielen Überraschungen.

programme.title: Gärten des Grauens
programme.desc: Die Dokumentation setzt sich mit dem umweltfeindlichen Trend hin zum Steingarten auseinander.

programme.title: Blindspots - Blind um die Welt
programme.desc: James Rath kehrt nach Los Angeles zurück, wo er vor der Pandemie zu Hause war. Dort trifft er alte Freunde wieder, die in der Unterhaltungsindustrie im Bereich Barrierefreiheit arbeiten. Außerdem genießt er ein koreanisches Barbecue und geht surfen.

programme.title: Blindspots - Blind um die Welt
programme.desc: Nach einer überraschenden Einladung, den Leiter der Abteilung für Barrierefreiheit in der Microsoft-Zentrale in Seattle zu besuchen, macht sich James auf den Weg nach Vancouver. Die Stadt gilt als barrierefreieste Stadt der Welt.

programme.title: Blindspots - Blind um die Welt
programme.desc: Wie steht es um die Barrierefreiheit in New York City, einer der größten Städte der Welt? James Rath stürzt sich in ein Abenteuer im Big Apple, um herauszufinden, ob er sich dort als Blinder durchschlagen kann.

programme.title: Blindspots - Blind um die Welt
programme.desc: James Rath fliegt über den großen Teich, um herauszufinden, wie gut man als blinder Reisender in London zurechtkommt. In der multikulturellen Metropole macht er sich mit der britisch-indischen Küche vertraut und lernt eine neue Sportart kennen.

programme.title: Blindspots - Blind um die Welt
programme.desc: James Rath nimmt den Zug hinein in das ländliche Großbritannien, um die Barrierefreiheit zu prüfen. Sein Weg führt über Gruseltouren mit Wandern in Schottland über Fußball in Liverpool bis hin zu einem aufregenden Fahrgeschäft in Wales.

programme.title: Mit dem Rucksack durch Nepal
programme.desc: Die Brüder Dennis und Patrick Weinert begeben sich auf eine dreimonatige Reise durch Nepal. Neben Abenteuern im Dschungel und auf Bergen treffen die Brüder auch auf Einheimische und reden mit ihnen über die Beziehung von Mensch und Natur.

programme.title: Abenteuer Israel - Zu Fuß durch ein begehrtes Land
programme.desc: Die Reportage begleitet zwei junge Deutsche, Kim und Eike, bei ihrer Wanderung durch Israel. Sie sprechen mit jungen Israelis darüber, was es heute für sie bedeutet, jüdisch zu sein. Der letzte Teil der Reise führt die beiden durch die Wüste Negev.

programme.desc: James Rath kehrt nach Los Angeles zurück, wo er vor der Pandemie zu Hause war. Dort trifft er alte Freunde wieder, die in der Unterhaltungsindustrie im Bereich Barrierefreiheit arbeiten. Außerdem genießt er ein koreanisches Barbecue und geht surfen.

programme.title: Blindspots - Blind um die Welt
programme.desc: Nach einer überraschenden Einladung, den Leiter der Abteilung für Barrierefreiheit in der Microsoft-Zentrale in Seattle zu besuchen, macht sich James auf den Weg nach Vancouver. Die Stadt gilt als barrierefreieste Stadt der Welt.

programme.title: Blindspots - Blind um die Welt
programme.desc: Wie steht es um die Barrierefreiheit in New York City, einer der größten Städte der Welt? James Rath stürzt sich in ein Abenteuer im Big Apple, um herauszufinden, ob er sich dort als Blinder durchschlagen kann.

programme.title: Blindspots - Blind um die Welt
programme.desc: James Rath fliegt über den großen Teich, um herauszufinden, wie gut man als blinder Reisender in London zurechtkommt. In der multikulturellen Metropole macht er sich mit der britisch-indischen Küche vertraut und lernt eine neue Sportart kennen.

programme.title: Blindspots - Blind um die Welt
programme.desc: James Rath nimmt den Zug hinein in das ländliche Großbritannien, um die Barrierefreiheit zu prüfen. Sein Weg führt über Gruseltouren mit Wandern in Schottland über Fußball in Liverpool bis hin zu einem aufregenden Fahrgeschäft in Wales.

programme.title: Mit dem Rucksack durch Nepal
programme.desc: Die Brüder Dennis und Patrick Weinert begeben sich auf eine dreimonatige Reise durch Nepal. Neben Abenteuern im Dschungel und auf Bergen treffen die Brüder auch auf Einheimische und reden mit ihnen über die Beziehung von Mensch und Natur.

programme.title: Abenteuer Israel - Zu Fuß durch ein begehrtes Land
programme.desc: Die Reportage begleitet zwei junge Deutsche, Kim und Eike, bei ihrer Wanderung durch Israel. Sie sprechen mit jungen Israelis darüber, was es heute für sie bedeutet, jüdisch zu sein. Der letzte Teil der Reise führt die beiden durch die Wüste Negev.

programme.title: Re:
programme.desc: Albanien wurde lange mit Kriminalität, Korruption und der Abwanderung der Bevölkerung in Verbindung gebracht. Mittlerweile entwickelt sich das Land an der Adria nicht nur zur interessanten Urlaubsdestination, sondern auch zu einem Auswanderer-Ziel.

programme.title: Re:
programme.sub-title: Klimaschutz oder Krawall? Der Widerstand der Letzten Generation
programme.desc: Die Klima-Aktivisten der Letzten Generation sorgen seit über einem Jahr für jede Menge Aufmerksamkeit: Maja Winkelmann und Henning Jeschke, von Anfang an dabei, sind überzeugt: Es ist das letzte Mittel, um die Erde vor dem Untergang zu retten.

programme.title: Titans of Defense
programme.desc: In befreundeten und feindlichen Gewässern verfügen die am feinsten abgestimmten Kriegsschiffe und U-Boote der Militärgeschichte über Fähigkeiten in den Bereichen Tarnfähigkeit, Geschwindigkeit, Tragfähigkeit und Angriffsstärke.

programme.title: Titans of Defense
programme.desc: Ob sie wichtige Versorgungsgüter zum Schlachtfeld fliegen, über Kampfeinsätzen schweben oder internationale Missionen unter schwierigsten Bedingungen durchführen: Militärhubschrauber sind für ihre Aufgaben bestens gerüstet.

programme.title: Geniale Mega-Maschinen
programme.desc: Die Sendung befasst sich mit großen Maschinen der Luftfahrt. Stählerne Kolosse wie das Militärtransportflugzeug C5 Galaxy, ein Flugzeug mit einer enorm hohen Ladekapazität, übersteigen dabei die Vorstellungskraft der modernen Technik.

programme.title: Interview With a Killer

programme.title: Interview With a Killer

programme.title: Interview With a Killer

programme.title: Colorado Serenade
programme.desc: One night, while out riding his horse, Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) comes upon a stagecoach being robbed by bandits. After witnessing Dean's heroics, the judge enlists the cowboy to help him, but their efforts are complicated by the arrival of mysterious drifter Nevada (David Sharpe).

programme.title: Black Hills
programme.desc: When their father is shot by Dan Kirby (Terry Frost) after discovering a gold mine on his ranch, Larry Hadley (Steve Drake) and his sister, Janet (Shirley Patterson), ask foreman Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) for help in retaining their land. Eddie's arrival with sidekick Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) disrupts Dan's plans to take over the property. Desperate to obtain the ranch, Dan blackmails accountant Tuttle (Bill Fawcett) into forging a document that will help him take control.

programme.title: Little Big Horn

As they race against time, and Donlin pushes them hard through an arduous and dangerous journey, the Sioux start taking out the soldiers one at a time. Meanwhile, Donlin also clashes with Lt. John Haywood (John Ireland), who Donlin knows is having an affair with his wife, Celie (Marie Windsor).

When Davis and his sidekick, Fuzzy (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), capture the outlaws, they collect reward money to distribute to the ranchers. But Fuzzy, who is in charge of delivering it, loses the money as well as his memory. Now it's up to Davis to set things right and prevent land baron Jim Kirby (George Chesebro) from getting his hands on the cash.

During the chase, Tommy is killed by Jack, and Roy and Rusty decide to cross the border into Mexico to find the outlaw. But Jack has plenty of reinforcements waiting, and Roy and Rusty may be in over their heads.

programme.title: Down Missouri Way
programme.desc: In this musical, agriculture professor Jane Colwell (Martha O'Driscoll) is seeking a quiet getaway when she takes her prized mule off to visit an Ozarks farming community. But upon arrival she is stunned to discover a film crew diligently at work on a new movie. Soon, Jane and her mule companion are swept up in the filmmaking frenzy. While the photogenic mule upstages the production's human star (Renee Godfrey), Jane finds herself falling for the feature's dashing producer (William Wright).

programme.title: Susanna Pass
programme.desc: After finding a large oil bed underneath a lake, crooked engineer Del Roberts (Douglas Fowley) plots to take control of a fish hatchery run by Russell Masters (Lucien Littlefield), brother of Roberts' accomplice, Martin Masters (Robert Emmett Keane). Acting sheriff Roy (Roy Rogers) and his deputies square off against Roberts and his henchmen, and visiting female ichthyologist "Doc" Parker (Dale Evans) is caught in the crossfire between the opposing camps.

programme.title: Driftin' River
programme.desc: The cavalry asks cowboy Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) to inspect 300 horses they're looking to purchase from J.C. Morgan (Shirley Patterson), to assist the Army in battling outlaw attacks on railroad construction workers. Eddie and friend Soapy (Roscoe Ates) visit J.C.'s ranch, unaware that the attacks are being conducted by outlaw Marino (Dennis Moore), who owns the town saloon. Fearing the rail expansion will end his stage business, Marino attacks J.C.'s horses, and she turns to Eddie for help.

programme.title: Pit Pony
programme.desc: A horse's companionship helps a boy overcome his fears and work in a Nova Scotia coal mine to support his family.

programme.title: Stage to Mesa City
programme.desc: Valiant U.S. Marshal Cheyenne Davis (Al "Lash" La Rue) and his trusty deputy, Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), are on their way to aid a stagecoach owner who is mired in financial burdens. But, when they arrive and discover he's been murdered, the loyal pair are asked by Margie (Jennifer Holt), his daughter, to seek out his killers and make them pay for their vile crime. The investigation soon leads them to a sneering lawyer (Marshall Reed), who has a mysterious boss.

programme.title: Stagecoach Outlaws
programme.desc: Cowboy Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe) enrages saloon owner Steve Kirby (Stanford Jolley) when he thwarts a bank robbery by Kirby's crew. But Kirby has more schemes up his sleeve. He sends his men to bust brutish outlaw Matt Brawley (Bob Kortman) out of jail for a new heist. When a case of mistaken identities leads to the bandits freeing harmless Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) instead, he decides to play along to help Billy. However, the real Brawley soon arrives to cause trouble.

programme.title: Blue Steel
programme.desc: Undercover federal marshal John Carruthers (John Wayne) is suspected by the local sheriff, Jake (George Hayes), of stealing the town's payroll, but his suspicions are sidelined when young Betty Mason (Eleanor Hunt) announces that her father, an important businessman, has been murdered. Without him, supplies will not reach town, and homesteaders will starve. When town leader Malgrove (Edward Peil) offers to buy the locals out, John and Jake get suspicious, and uncover a land-grabbing conspiracy.

programme.title: Bill Dance Saltwater
programme.desc: Freshwater fishing has always come naturally to Bill Dance, who has entertained and educated viewers in that fishing discipline on "Bill Dance Outdoors" since 1968. But the challenges on the water don't stop there for the three-time B.A.S.S. Angler of the Year, and this one has nothing to do with largemouth bass. Redfish, speckled trout, shark, snook and tarpon are on the "Bill Dance Saltwater" menu, with Dance and noted saltwater experts and guides hitting inshore spots from Long Island to Key West in search of mainstream saltwater species, with more than a touch of Dance's trademark teaching skills and humor thrown in for good measure.

programme.title: Gale Force Twins

programme.title: Wild at Heart

programme.title: Flight to Hong Kong
programme.desc: An importer-exporter (Rory Calhoun) double-crosses his girlfriends (Barbara Rush, Dolores Donlon) and the mob he works for in Macao.

programme.title: Outpost in Malaya
programme.desc: An English rubber planter (Jack Hawkins) and his wife (Claudette Colbert) have marital trouble during a native uprising.

programme.title: Top of the World
programme.desc: A jet pilot finds himself assigned to the barren wastes of Alaska where it becomes his duty to man an observation post.

programme.title: 99 River Street
programme.desc: Cab driver and ex-boxer Ernie (John Payne) discovers his wife Pauline (Peggie Castle) has been cheating on him. Ernie is approached by actress friend Linda (Evelyn Keyes), who says that she needs his help because she killed a man during an audition. After rushing to the theater, Ernie discovers that Linda's desperate tale was the audition. As if that humiliation isn't enough, Ernie is then framed for Pauline's murder by her lover, jewel thief Victor Rawlins (Brad Dexter).

programme.title: Big House, U.S.A.
programme.desc: Extortionist Jerry Barker (Ralph Meeker) accidentally comes upon a runaway child and uses the opportunity to take the boy and demand a ransom. After collecting the money, Barker flees when he discovers the boy has accidentally fallen to his death. The FBI becomes involved, and Barker is apprehended, but without a body, he's only sentenced for extortion. In prison, Barker is placed with hardened criminal Rollo Lambert (Broderick Crawford), who plots a breakout to get the hidden ransom.

programme.desc: Capt. Barnaby (Edward G. Robinson), leader of the Los Angeles Vice Squad, is trying to track down the murderers of a beat cop. Using this lead and further help from an informant, Barnaby hunts down a pair of bank robbers he suspects are the killers. However, the criminals prove to be hard to catch, so Barnaby must stay determined.

programme.desc: Trouble comes to a tropical island paradise when sacred pearls are stolen from a tribal temple. Local amateur sleuth Tana (Ann Corio) decides to investigate the matter to find out who's responsible, but following leads only earns her a place on the authorities' list of suspects. Meanwhile, a police officer, Jim (James Bush), is injured while working on the case, and Tana, nursing him back to health, attempts to get him to team up with her to track down the real crooks.

programme.title: Legend of the Lost
programme.desc: Brit Paul Bonnard (Rossano Brazzi) enlists gruff American Joe January (John Wayne) to help him find a hidden treasure that is worth a fortune. Before long, they are joined by prostitute Dita (Sophia Loren), who is moved by Bonnard's earnestness, and the three embark on a journey through the wild in hopes of finding an ancient lost city. They finally stumble upon the riches, but, after Bonnard feuds with Dita, he angrily takes the jewels and supplies, and leaves his partners to die in the desert.

programme.title: Kill a Dragon
programme.desc: When a valuable shipment of nitroglycerin washes ashore on an island near Hong Kong, the natives think it's theirs, owing to the law of salvage. However, local mob boss Nico Patrai thinks otherwise and gives the islanders three days to return it before he starts killing them. Rather than give in, the islanders hire soldier of fortune Rick Masters to help them smuggle the shipment off the island and sell it in Hong Kong.

programme.title: Hercules Against Karate
programme.desc: Two martial artists go to Hong Kong to rescue a restaurateur's son from the clutches of an evil kung fu master.

programme.title: Rage
programme.desc: The adopted son from a prominent Asian business family lives the perfect life until his rival stepbrother launches a murder conspiracy plot in order to take over the family's multi-billion dollar trading corporation.

programme.title: Born Losers
programme.desc: A biker gang incites a reign of terror in a California coastal town that culminates in four teenage girls being raped. Vietnam veteran Billy Jack (Tom Laughlin) has had enough, however, and takes on the depraved bikers single-handedly. He rescues young Vicky Barrington (Elizabeth James) from their clutches, but then has to contend with not only the thugs, but also the ineffectual and racist local lawmen, who have it out for the half-Native American Billy.

programme.title: Cast a Giant Shadow
programme.desc: In this fact-based film, distinguished U.S. Army Col. David Marcus (Kirk Douglas) is enlisted by the Israelis to perform the difficult task of preparing their fledgling nation for battle against the Arabs. Before long, he feuds with the local leaders, quits his post and goes back home to his pregnant wife (Angie Dickinson) in the United States. However, Marcus, who is Jewish himself, soon has a crisis of faith and decides to return to duty to help the untrained Israelis form an army.

programme.title: Black Mama, White Mama
programme.desc: Lee Daniels (Pam Grier) is a black girl busted for prostitution. Karen Brent (Margaret Markov) is a white girl arrested for her involvement with a local revolutionary group. The two women meet in jail and, despite their mutual animosity, are chained together for transport to a maximum security prison. Their bus is ambushed en route, however, and the pair manages to escape together. Chased by bounty hunters, crooked police and revolutionaries, they struggle to get along and get away.

programme.title: Friday Foster
programme.desc: On assignment from her editor, photographer Friday Foster (Pam Grier) travels to an airport to capture a few shots of the richest black man in the United States (Thalmus Rasulala). But it turns out Foster isn't the only one taking shots as she witnesses -- and photographs -- an assassination attempt on her subject. With definitive evidence in her possession, she also becomes a target of the assassins. Joining a private eye (Yaphet Kotto), Foster sets out to discover the truth behind the attempt.

programme.title: Sheba, Baby
programme.desc: When the loan business of her father, Andy (Rudy Challenger), is trashed by thugs looking to force a sale, Chicago private investigator Sheba Shayne (Pam Grier) travels back to her hometown of Louisville, Ky., to even the score. Together with old flame Brick Williams (Austin Stoker), she attacks the henchmen of local loan shark Pilot (D'Urville Martin), but a retaliation leaves Andy dead. Blind with rage, Sheba vows to take out Pilot's boss, mob kingpin Shark (Dick Merrifield).

programme.title: Bucktown, U.S.A.

programme.title: Diggstown
programme.desc: After being released from a Georgia prison, smooth-talking con man Gabriel Caine (James Woods) teams up with his partner in crime, Fitz (Oliver Platt), and travels to remote Diggstown. Upon arriving, Fitz and Caine bet the wealthiest resident, former boxing manager John Gillon (Bruce Dern), that they know a guy who can beat Diggstown's 10 best fighters in one day. After Caine reels in "Honey" Roy Palmer (Louis Gossett Jr.), an aging boxer and old acquaintance, the grift is on.

programme.title: Hammer
programme.desc: Hotheaded laborer B.J. Hammer (Fred Williamson) can't go long without ending up in a fight, and, after he comes out on top in a particularly impressive workplace scuffle, word of his brawling skills makes its way to Davis (Bernie Hamilton), a top boxing manager. Hammer is hired by Davis and begins a lucrative career in the ring, only to find out that his new employer wants him to throw a fight and take part in other illicit activities. Hammer reacts to this news violently, and the feud is on.

programme.title: Soda Cracker
programme.desc: A Chicago police officer practices his own brand of justice to take down the killers who murdered his partner.

programme.title: Hell up in Harlem
programme.desc: In Harlem, N.Y., crime boss Tommy Gibbs (Fred Williamson) is gravely injured while escaping a hit ordered by the corrupt district attorney, D'Angelo (Gerald Gordon). As he recovers, his father, Papa Gibbs (Julius W. Harris), assumes control of the gang, which angers Tommy's best henchman, Zach (Tony King), who goes on to collaborate with D'Angelo and frame Papa Gibbs for the murder of Tommy's ex-wife. This sets off a series of bloody betrayals that ricochet within the crime world.

programme.title: Black Caesar
programme.desc: Growing up on the tough streets of Harlem, Tommy Gibbs (Fred Williamson) has his life made even harder by John McKinney (Art Lund), a crooked cop who breaks the boy's leg, crippling him for life. Drawing on his anger at the racism he faces on a daily basis, Tommy grows up to become the crime kingpin of Harlem. Now that he has the power, he aims to take down New York's Mafia bosses -- and also get bloody revenge on his nemesis, McKinney, no matter what the cost.

programme.title: J.D.'s Revenge
programme.desc: Although notorious New Orleans gangster J.D. Walker (David McKnight) is shot and killed in the 1940s, his spirit remains restless for three decades, until a hypnotist's supernatural nightclub act allows him to take over the body of Isaac (Glynn Turman), a mild-mannered law student. After inhabiting Isaac, Walker decides to hunt down the Rev. Elija Bliss (Louis Gossett Jr.), a former criminal who helped the authorities find and assassinate the mobster years ago.

programme.title: Sugar Hill
programme.desc: When nightclub owner Langston (Larry D. Johnson) refuses to sell out to local mob boss Morgan (Robert Quarry), he is beaten to death by a gang of hired thugs. His grief-stricken fiancée, Diana "Sugar" Hill (Marki Bey), vows revenge for his murder and turns to aged voodoo authority Mama Maitresse (Zara Cully). Together they conjure up the demonic spirit of Baron Samedi (Don Pedro Colley), who agrees to help Sugar. He raises an army of zombies and sets them upon Langston's killers.

programme.title: Blacula
programme.desc: During a visit to Transylvania, an African prince (William Marshall) gets turned into a vampire by Count Dracula (Charles Macaulay). Sealed in a coffin for several lifetimes, "Blacula" reawakens in the 1970s Los Angeles. Leaving a trail of bloodless victims in his wake, he pursues Lina (Vonetta McGee), a woman who bears a striking resemblance to his dead wife. Meanwhile, Dr. Gordon Thomas (Thalmus Rasulala) and top cop Lt. Peters (Gordon Pinsent) are hot on the bloodsucker's trail.

programme.title: Scream Blacula Scream
programme.desc: When a hated rival, Lisa Fortier (Pam Grier), is chosen to lead the voodoo cult of Willis Daniels' (Richard Lawson) late mother, a vengeful Willis brings the doomed vampire Prince Mamuwalde (William Marshall) back to life. Willis soon finds the vampire too powerful to control, and Lisa agrees to perform a spell that will break the curse placed on the prince. But, when racist sheriff Dunlop (Michael Conrad) gets involved, the vampire unleashes his deadly revenge.

programme.title: Fort Massacre
programme.desc: After his cavalry company is decimated by an Apache attack, Vinson takes charge and tries to lead his remaining men to safety. Unfortunately, his pathological hatred of Native Americans causes him to commit rash acts that put his troops in jeopardy. The enlisted men, especially the rebellious McGurney, question Vinson's leadership and even his morality, but the soldiers must stick together if they wish to make it through Apache lands.

programme.title: Terror in a Texas Town
programme.desc: When Swedish-American whaler George Hansen returns to his Texas hometown after 20 years at sea, he's shocked to learn that his father was murdered just two days prior. The feckless local sheriff won't do anything about it, so George investigates on his own and discovers that an oil speculator had his father killed for refusing to sell his land at an unfair price. Enraged, and armed only with a speargun, George goes looking for justice.

programme.title: Captain John Smith and Pocahontas
programme.desc: Back in England after his trip to Jamestown, Va., Capt. John Smith (Anthony Dexter) tells the tale of his journey, particularly his lost romance with Native American maiden Pocahontas (Jody Lawrence). They meet and gradually fall for each other when captured Smith is saved from certain death by the girl. But as Smith tries to maintain peace between the British colonists and local tribes, the task proves harrowing, and Smith's friend Rolfe (Robert Clarke) begins to move in on Pocahontas.

programme.title: Young Billy Young
programme.desc: Fleeing the scene of a gruesome gunfight in Mexico, Billy Young (Robert Walker) arrives in the small town of Lordsburg, where he is promptly deputized by local sheriff Ben Kane (Robert Mitchum). Kane takes the troubled young man under his wing, hoping to reform his lawless ways. As the bond between the two men grows stronger, Kane recruits Young for a particularly personal assignment: to help bring to justice Frank Boone (John Anderson), a vicious outlaw responsible for the death of his son.

programme.title: Man From Del Rio
programme.desc: Thanks to his prowess with a gun, Dave Robles (Anthony Quinn) makes a place for himself in Mesa, becoming sheriff after out-dueling several gunfighters in a single day. Dalglish (Wes Bentley) a surveyor looking to expand the railroad threatens the future of the town -- and 2 women from Dillon's past hold a secret that could be his undoing.

programme.title: Live: MLB Central
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown.".

programme.title: Live: MLB Now
programme.desc: The hourlong weekday afternoon "MLB Now" presents the day's top stories in baseball by spanning the sport's cultural divide. Host Brian Kenny discusses the issues and provides analysis, with a bent toward modern analytics to prove his points. The series also features interviews with personalities throughout the game, and viewer opinions are welcome as well via social media polls.

programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media.

programme.title: Here Comes the Boom
programme.desc: Once a collegiate wrestler, Scott Voss (Kevin James) is now a 42-year-old, apathetic biology teacher in a failing high school. When cutbacks threaten the school's music program and its teacher (Henry Winkler), Scott springs into action. He dusts off his long-unused wrestling skills and earns money for the program by moonlighting as a mixed martial arts fighter. Though the school nurse (Salma Hayek) thinks he's crazy, Scott gains something he never expected, and the school rallies behind him.

programme.title: Rush Hour
programme.desc: When a Chinese diplomat's daughter is kidnapped in Los Angeles, he calls in Hong Kong Detective Inspector Lee (Jackie Chan) to assist the FBI with the case. But the FBI doesn't want anything to do with Lee, and they dump him off on the LAPD, who assign wisecracking Detective James Carter (Chris Tucker) to watch over him. Although Lee and Carter can't stand each other, they choose to work together to solve the case on their own when they figure out they've been ditched by both the FBI and police.

programme.title: Muero por Marilú
programme.desc: Marilú es una secretaria que hereda de su jefe un por ciento de Funerales Garza Gallardo. Este porcentaje la convierte en la socia de Matías, hijo de don Anselmo y heredero, quien se ve impedido de vender el negocio por su nueva socia.

programme.title: Más vale sola

programme.title: Me caigo de risa
programme.desc: Show de improvisación protagonizado por Faisy y su disfuncional familia.

programme.title: Faisy Nights
programme.desc: Melissa López y René Ortiz cuentan los planes a futuro del 90's Pop Tour y recuerdan qué tanto aprendieron en Magneto, JNS y Kabah, respectivamente. Luego, se enfrentan en una batalla de sabiduría musical.

programme.title: 40 y 20
programme.desc: Tras desaparecer dos días, Brayan desata la preocupación de Paco, Lucas y Magali, quienes imaginan todo tipo de escenarios, desde un secuestro hasta verlo coronado como reina gay en Veracruz. Su ausencia causa tal caos que Miranda aparece alterada.

programme.title: 40 y 20
programme.desc: Paco se reencuentra con Montserrat, una exnovia, y la invita a su departamento, pero todo se complica cuando ella descubre a un bebé en la casa y comienza a sospechar que es de Paco. Entre mentiras, enredos y excusas Paco no logra aclarar la situación.

programme.title: 40 y 20
programme.desc: Miranda llega al departamento porque tiene el fin de semana libre y les propone hacer algo diferente, total, ¿qué puede pasar?, y deciden irse de campamento al Ajusco. En plena fogata le avisan a Miranda que Lenny tiene temperatura.

programme.title: 40 y 20
programme.desc: Magali convence a Paco de recibir temporalmente a su amiga Cassandra, una hostess espectacular que necesita alojamiento urgente. Pero pronto se revela que Cassandra y Paco ya se conocen, de una boda donde él terminó ebrio y haciendo el ridículo.

programme.title: 40 y 20
programme.desc: Betochas cae de imprevisto después de que Lauris lo echa de su departamento y les pide ayuda para que ella lo perdone. Magali trata de convencer a Lauris, pero cacha a Beto con otra y decide llevarse de rumba a Lauris.

programme.title: 40 y 20
programme.desc: Por malos manejos, Lucas se ve en la necesidad de organizar una noche de rodeo en el departamento, pero el evento se descontrola: hay un toro mecánico en la sala, Magali se viste de vaquerita, Brayan de payaso y una multitud que entra a la fuerza.

programme.desc: Esta serie dramática representa en cada capítulo de una hora historias distintas y reales sobre mujeres mexicanas que atraviesan diferentes vicisitudes. Las experiencias de estas mujeres tratan de temas censurados por la sociedad y por lo tanto ellas los enfrentan en silencio, algunas de las situaciones que se examinan son: el abuso infantil, el embarazo no deseado, asesinatos, la pornografía y la violencia familiar entre otras. Al final de cada episodio se muestra una lista de centros o agencias de ayuda para personas que se sientan identificadas con los casos específicos, se hace un llamado para que busquen ayuda y rompan su silencio.

programme.title: ¿Quién tiene la razón?
programme.desc: Programa de charlas en el que los participantes invitados exponen sus casos ante la presentadora buscando consejo profesional. Los casos incluyen conflictos en temas variados, entre familias, parejas y amigos o relacionados. Ella guía con preguntas y consejos a los participantes y en muchos casos los confronta y acusa para que acepten sus errores cometidos por hecho o negligencia. A su lado la acompañan un grupo de tres panelistas, quienes eligen individualmente con quién están de acuerdo o en desacuerdo, después de haber escuchado atentamente a las partes en cuestión. También acompañando a la doctora Âlvarez está la audiencia presente en el estudio formando parte activa del show; la cual entrega el veredicto final, eligiendo por votación al panelista que tiene la razón o en algunos casos concluyendo que ninguno tiene la razón.

programme.title: Casos de familia
programme.desc: Personas comunes y corrientes se reúnen en el escenario para exponer sus historias reales y dramas personales, ellos comentan sus casos ante la audiencia presente y ante el público televidente. La anfitriona del programa se encarga de conducir a los panelistas para exponer sus casos en forma clara, sacar una conclusión al problema y tratar de solucionarlo, gracias a su carisma y habilidad para conectarse con sus invitados de una manera positiva con sus análisis objetivos, ella, por lo general encuentra la solución a los conflictos. Los temas tratados son diversos, incluyendo conflictos familiares, problemas entre socios, infidelidad, paternidad, entre otros.

programme.title: ¿Quién tiene la razón?
programme.desc: Programa de charlas en el que los participantes invitados exponen sus casos ante la presentadora buscando consejo profesional. Los casos incluyen conflictos en temas variados, entre familias, parejas y amigos o relacionados. Ella guía con preguntas y consejos a los participantes y en muchos casos los confronta y acusa para que acepten sus errores cometidos por hecho o negligencia. A su lado la acompañan un grupo de tres panelistas, quienes eligen individualmente con quién están de acuerdo o en desacuerdo, después de haber escuchado atentamente a las partes en cuestión. También acompañando a la doctora Âlvarez está la audiencia presente en el estudio formando parte activa del show; la cual entrega el veredicto final, eligiendo por votación al panelista que tiene la razón o en algunos casos concluyendo que ninguno tiene la razón.

programme.desc: Toprak despierta de un coma tras cinco años sin recordar nada de su pasado, y regresa a una familia que no reconoce, incluida su prometida de toda la vida y un niño que vive con él. Sin embargo, su amnesia lo mantiene en una incertidumbre constante.

programme.title: Lo sé todo
programme.desc: El mejor equipo de entretenimiento mezcla el humor con investigación, además de entrevistas a artistas invitados, se realizan denuncias sociales y políticas y también hay espacio para la última información de la farándula.

programme.title: Historias de la Virgen morena
programme.desc: A veces los problemas del día a día pueden solucionarse con un poco de ayuda milagrosa. Esta exitosa serie muestra casos de la vida real en los cuales los protagonistas se enfrentan a grandes encrucijadas o a situaciones terribles, y no les queda más remedio que pedir un milagro. Es allí cuando la fe se pone a prueba y se vuelve poderosa, pues demuestra que de la situación más terrible se puede salir. Pensado para quienes creen que la fe mueve montañas, esta conmovedora serie muestra la manera en la que los protagonistas se encomiendan a la Virgen Morena buscando resolver sus dificultades.

programme.desc: Un espacio en el que se celebra la música mexicana. Una ventana muy importante para las expresiones artísticas de México.

programme.title: El África de Lumumba
programme.desc: Espacio donde se centra en los problemas del pasado y presente que afectan al continente africano. Se analizan las dicotomías de África, el porqué unas naciones florecen, otras parecen que están estancadas, entre otros temas.

programme.title: SanaMente
programme.desc: Especialistas y expertos comparten recomendaciones sobre la prevención de enfermedades y la salud integral.

programme.title: Cazador de cascadas
programme.desc: Una aventura por el departamento de Antioquia para conocer el esplendor oculto en sus cavernas, parajes y arboledas espesas.

programme.title: Enchilémonos
programme.sub-title: Salsa de cacahuate y salsa de chilcoxtle
programme.desc: Se enfoca en una de las vetas gastronómicas de México que hacen única y diversa a su cocina: las salsas. En cada programa, la chef Lourdes Hernández presenta la preparación de dos deliciosas salsas.

programme.title: Bio guardianes
programme.desc: El documental teje las historias de una red de Bioguardianes, relacionados con especies icónicas de la fauna silvestre del país, a través de leyendas mexicanas, y busca dar a conocer las acciones de conservación que se realizan para protegerlas.

programme.title: Cuerpos migrantes
programme.desc: Un proyecto que parte de la idea de que cada uno se piense como cuerpos en continua migración: de una cultura a otra, de una geografía a otra, de una identidad a otra, de un cuerpo a otro, de un género a otro, de una realidad a otra.

programme.desc: Una mirada a la Señora Seis Mono, una mujer que encarna la sabiduría y el linaje sagrado para el pueblo Ñuu Savi en la Mixteca Alta, Oaxaca.

programme.title: La ruleta de la suerte
programme.desc: Una de las versiones españolas del programa de concurso clásico norteamericano de gran acogida que se inició en los años setenta, titulado "Wheel of Fortune" o la "Ruleta de la fortuna" en español. Este formato se ha realizado en más de 25 países y se ha extendido al público internacional. Los concursantes deben adivinar oraciones sobre temas variados, llenando los vacíos con letras adivinadas que ellos enuncian, el que adivine una letra perteneciente a la frase gana un premio monetario y el premio se incrementa si adivina la frase completa. Se realizan varias rondas, en la que se incrementa la dificultad y la complejidad de los temas que se abordan.

programme.title: La ruleta de la suerte
programme.desc: Una de las versiones españolas del programa de concurso clásico norteamericano de gran acogida que se inició en los años setenta, titulado "Wheel of Fortune" o la "Ruleta de la fortuna" en español. Este formato se ha realizado en más de 25 países y se ha extendido al público internacional. Los concursantes deben adivinar oraciones sobre temas variados, llenando los vacíos con letras adivinadas que ellos enuncian, el que adivine una letra perteneciente a la frase gana un premio monetario y el premio se incrementa si adivina la frase completa. Se realizan varias rondas, en la que se incrementa la dificultad y la complejidad de los temas que se abordan.

programme.title: Planeta helado

Grabado en su totalidad en alta definición e incluye cinematografía con tecnología de punta, para capturar el comportamiento de los animales sin ser disturbados, este programa hace una crónica de los ecosistemas y de los animales del Ártico y el Antártico, lugares en el que los cineastas pasaron 2.300 días y en el océano 18 meses para grabar cortos sin precedentes. Los episodios siguen las vidas de los osos polares, los lobos, las ballenas asesinas y los pingüinos, desde la primavera hasta el invierno y además hay un episodio que detalla los desafíos enfrentados por el equipo que realizó el documental. La serie es narrada por Alec Baldwin y el séptimo episodio incluye una visión sobre los efectos del calentamiento global en los polos y el resto.
