programme.title: 星際鈍胎 / Twinkle Twinkle Little Star
programme.desc: 美麗但無知的李天珍被外星人捉上飛碟，事後無人相信她曾與外星人接觸。於是，當她打算一死以示清白之際，卻遇上同有輕生念頭的失敗私家偵探伊電。二人互吐心聲後改變主意，卻遭遇一連串奇遇，而二人的愛情故事也因此開始。.

programme.title: 吉祥賭坊 / The Casino
programme.desc: 一對青梅竹馬的情侶相隔多年後在神秘的吉祥賭坊相遇，二人決意要一起剷除貪污的將軍、罪犯和勒索者！.

programme.title: 魔界 / Hell Has No Boundary
programme.desc: 故事講述，警局偵緝部情侶探員鄭忠與王麗芬同往離島露營，半夜麗芬忽聞異聲，離營探看，突見綠光一閃，隨即著魔。翌日，王警官率眾處理一宗挾持人質案件，期間麗芬逕自開槍射殺劫匪，過程被雜誌記者阿古攝得，發現子彈竟能轉向殺人...

programme.title: 陰陽刀 / Twin Blades Of Doom
programme.desc: 大俠張七郎退隱江湖多年，他的妻兒及朋友卻被鬼頭黨所殺。悲憤的七郎打算獨力與鬼王決一生死，為他們報仇雪恨！惡名昭彰的鬼頭黨最終會被他打敗嗎？.

programme.title: 決殺令 / Judgement of an Assassin
programme.desc: 百毒派銳意製造武林不和，以實現稱霸江湖的野心。他們派出蒙面刺客殺戮另一門派，但其中一名刺客被捕後即被其他門派公審。最後審訊結果是什麼？最終又能否揭開真相？.

programme.title: 楊貴妃 / The Magnificent Concubine
programme.desc: 唐明皇十分寵愛妃子楊貴妃，導致終日尋歡作樂，荒廢國事，更將所有國事交貴妃之兄丞相楊國忠處理。丞相卻因貪贓枉法，暴虐無道，引起軍民共憤。民眾乘機造反要弒唐明皇，貴妃自知難逃一死，於是最終投繯自盡。.

programme.title: 瘋猴 / Mad Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: 陳百精通「猴拳」，但卻被惡霸設計陷害，更廢了他雙手。陳百終淪落為流浪藝人，直到遇上街頭小子小侯，決將一身「猴拳」，傾囊相授。最後師徒二人聯手，勢要一雪前恥。.

programme.title: 大軍閥 / The Warlord
programme.desc: 一名土匪因助俄國抗擊日本而成為北方的大軍閥。由於他好大喜功又目不識丁，老百姓當他是個大笑話。後來，當年曾被他無端殺死的戲班老闆之女出現，槍殺了這個賣國賊。.

programme.title: 小煞星 / The Singing Killer
programme.desc: 強宜本是夜總會歌星，後來為尋初戀女友水仙的下落，被人帶到匪幫的木屋。原來，強宜少年時誤入歧途，有打劫殺人的犯罪紀錄，綽號「小煞星」。一哥要脅他共同打劫珠寶行，否則公開他的秘密。強宜假意應承，從長計議。想不到當日行動踏入珠寶行，發現售貨員竟然是初戀女友水仙！.

programme.title: 香江花月夜 / Hong Kong Nocturne
programme.desc: 本歌舞片由聲色藝各有千秋的何莉莉、鄭佩佩及秦萍合演三姊妹，再配以三大小生淩雲、陳厚及嶽華大鬥演技。由日本名演導井上梅次執導.

programme.title: 黑店 / The Black Tavern
programme.desc: 故事講述，江湖上傳出消息，巡撫海剛峰辭官歸里，所攜箱篋中珠寶價值連城，於是引起了一些歹人的覬覦。高家店店主高山峰、其姘婦鄧三娘，以及數幫黑道人物，均於高家店埋伏，準備等待海剛峰經過之時伺機下手….

programme.title: 鬥氣小神仙 / Puppy Love
programme.desc: 丁安安與雍晴兩個表姐妹自小就讀於同一所女校，因二人的母親一向口和心不和，從小就向自己女兒灌輸好勝思想，因此形成安安與晴從小鬥到大，三日一小吵，五日一大鬥。她們在校中認識了男同學米高及保羅，很快成為情侶，兩對小冤家後來因鬥氣竟然互調了男朋友….

programme.title: 五遁忍術 / Five Elements Ninjas
programme.desc: 東瀛武士挑戰武林盟主袁增，戰敗後切腹自盡。忍者之王劍淵率領忍者渡海復仇，並佈下威力驚人的「五遁忍術」奇陣。袁增門下高手不諳忍術詭計，貿然迎戰竟全軍覆沒。倖存弟子潛心鑽研五遁之法，誓要以其人之道還治其人之身，破陣雪恥。.

programme.title: 銷魂玉 / Return Of The Dead
programme.desc: 王致和無意得到通靈玩意，許下三個願望，雖然願望靈驗之極，結果落得家散人亡；風塵女孟薇被情人林坤全害死，變成水鬼復仇；豔麗女子蕭雲玉香消玉殞後，仍不斷在人間走動，盜墳贼欲挖開蕭雲玉墳墓盜取陪葬珠寶，終被蕭雲玉追殺致死...

programme.title: 銷魂玉 / Return Of The Dead
programme.desc: 王致和無意得到通靈玩意，許下三個願望，雖然願望靈驗之極，結果落得家散人亡；風塵女孟薇被情人林坤全害死，變成水鬼復仇；豔麗女子蕭雲玉香消玉殞後，仍不斷在人間走動，盜墳贼欲挖開蕭雲玉墳墓盜取陪葬珠寶，終被蕭雲玉追殺致死...

programme.title: 五大漢 / Five Tough Guys
programme.desc: 一班不打不相識之眾，聚集在一起以保護愛國將軍免被加害。他們充當將軍的護送人員，前往危險的遠方英國領事館，途中遭到敵人和日軍的陰險干擾。.

programme.title: 降頭 / Black Magic
programme.desc: 狄龍劇中為一準新郎，但卻遇上心術不正的恬妮單戀癡纏，更借助邪術降頭，務求奪取男方歡心。後恬妮裙下之臣羅烈及狄龍未婚妻，亦相繼加入戰團。一場因為愛而生與死的鬥爭，複雜的關係加上正邪大鬥法，將人性為達一己私慾的惡行，表露無遺。至於邪是否不能勝正？且看結局便有分曉。.

programme.title: 鬼馬兩金剛 / Crazy Nuts Of Kung Fu
programme.desc: 一名強盜和一位居無定所的賭徒合作以賭賺錢。一天，他們成功從叛國軍閥屋裡偷取一大筆金錢，途中卻遇上革命戰士，並希望他們能資助革命叛軍計劃。二人是否會用偷來的財富協助革命戰士？.

programme.title: 鬼太監 / The Eunuch
programme.desc: 鬼太監桂德海追殺世子朱锦，朱锦得青竹叟相救才倖免於難。桂當年與啞巴月仙誕下一女燕燕，桂竟利用父女之情，假借燕燕之手殺朱锦...

programme.title: 風流斷劍小小刀 / The Deadly Breaking Sword
programme.desc: 大俠段長青在一小鎮得遇名妓柳銀絮，柳懇求段殺死現以「神醫」為名的黑道高手郭天勝，為其未婚夫報仇。段聯同鎮內賭坊護衛高門殺入郭家，正邪兩派惡鬥連場。.

programme.title: 雙鳳奇緣 / The Female Prince
programme.desc: 秦鳳笙、鳳簫兄妹才情敏捷，滿腹經綸，卻常受繼母夏氏刻薄。鳳簫自幼許與李如龍為妻，夏氏貪圖富貴，強逼如龍退婚；如龍不肯，夏氏再施毒計誣告如龍偷盜，將其收在獄中。鳳簫為救如龍，與侍婢春蘭喬扮男裝上京，更以如龍之名赴考，一舉中恩科狀元。明世宗見鳳簫長得一表非凡，乃命相國為媒，招為駙馬。洞房之夕，鳳簫向公主言明真相，並說服公主，安排一條妙計….

programme.title: 大盜歌王 / The Singing Thief
programme.desc: 一名珠寶神偷棄邪歸正，搖身一變成為夜總會歌手。發生連串搶劫案後，他馬上又成為嫌疑犯。於是，神偷設計捉拿冒認者，最終會否連累自己？.

programme.title: 徐老虎與白寡婦 / The Tiger and the Widow
programme.desc: 本片改編自高陽同名著作，獲第18屆金馬獎最佳服裝設計、最佳美術設計兩項獎。本片講述清朝食鹽私梟徐老虎與白寡婦因清官李振彪拒不受賄，再加上責令嚴緝私鹽，二人面臨緝案危機。為免同僚落網，白獨擔罪責。徐悉白被處死，一心復仇….

programme.title: 六刺客 / Six Assassins
programme.desc: 鎮國公李明恃強作惡，魚肉百姓。他的兄長雖是當今聖上，卻對李明的惡行束手無策。正氣凜然的劍客穆俊傑假扮成李明的護衛密謀刺殺行動。他先捉拿六名欲殺李明的刺客，再與他們結盟，密謀殺死李明以終止其暴行。.

programme.title: 七仙女 / A Maid From Heaven
programme.desc: 故事描述少年董永賣身傳員外家，為奴以埋父骨；其孝心感動了七仙女，便幻成村姑，在六位仙姐下凡暗助下，為董縮減償還工作日，回復自由後，二人回董故家，但愉快的凡間生活能持續多久呢？.

programme.title: 毒龍潭 / Dragon Swamp
programme.desc: 樊瑛受歹徒唐大川欺騙，盜去師父的玉龍劍，並生下一子一女；後樊遭師罰禁毒龍潭，唐抱子虞江逃走，女青兒則歸師公門下；二十年後，劍再次被盜，青女扮男裝，私下尋劍，卻遇樊舊友天涯客...

programme.title: 夕陽戀人 / Sunset
programme.desc: 這是日本導演上梅次文藝片的經典。故事描述井莉飾的車衣女工與秦沛飾的修車工，在夕陽萌生感情，後女因識破男的太子爺身份，深感受騙...

programme.title: 飛刀手 / The Flying Dagger
programme.desc: 綽號飛刀追魂的焦雷與乾坤劍名手于遠結怨，焦要追殺于全家。幸得飛刀手楊青救了于的女兒于英；但楊青生性風流，向于英開出對付焦雷的條件是共渡一夜。于英憎惡他，又不得不和他一起助父親與焦雷決鬥。相處日久，于英才明白楊非登徒浪子，實對她深愛非常。.

programme.title: 女校春色 / Whose Baby is in the Classroom?
programme.desc: 化學教師陳子風在一間保守的女校任教，與青梅竹馬的李海倫共事。陳在醫務所拾得棄嬰，後把棄嬰帶到學校照顧，卻被學生謠傳嬰孩乃陳與李之私生子。陳不但輕鬆面對，還將朝氣帶入校園，大受學生歡迎，李亦漸漸愛上陳。但保守派對陳之作風不滿，侍機剷除陳。.

programme.title: 女校春色 / Whose Baby is in the Classroom?
programme.desc: 化學教師陳子風在一間保守的女校任教，與青梅竹馬的李海倫共事。陳在醫務所拾得棄嬰，後把棄嬰帶到學校照顧，卻被學生謠傳嬰孩乃陳與李之私生子。陳不但輕鬆面對，還將朝氣帶入校園，大受學生歡迎，李亦漸漸愛上陳。但保守派對陳之作風不滿，侍機剷除陳。.

programme.title: 怪俠 / The Magnificent Swordsman
programme.desc: 怪俠江丹楓全家都被土匪殺害，遂誓必殺盡此等敗類。一次，江殺土匪沙如虎，沙臨終時哀求江將遺物交予其妹秀秀，江允之；秀得知兄為江所殺，憤然拔刀將他砍傷，但她又後悔傷江，因其兄罪應該死，遂留江在家養傷，但江的行蹤已被盜首黃天霸發現..

programme.title: 北地胭脂 / Facets Of Love
programme.desc: 本片由三個發生在妓院「百花樓」的單元故事組成。〈花街柳巷〉講述妓女大琴不甘淪落為娼，竟冒險向巡官告狀，要求救她脫離火坑；〈滿宮春色〉講述同治皇帝大婚之前，往妓院尋歡，終於染上梅毒不治；〈游龍豔史〉講述正德皇帝與名妓佛動心同入鴛帳...

programme.title: 軍閥趣史 / The Scandalous Warlord
programme.desc: 此片可謂李翰祥導演，經典作《大軍閥》之延續，焦點在幾位當時得令的豔星，餘莎莉、邵音音及楚湘雲。片中「豔趣」特別多….

programme.title: 滿天神佛 / Ghosts Galore
programme.desc: 一次驅鬼時，青年術士魯興與友人因功力太差被女鬼戲弄險告喪命，幸得連大師施法幫助，才將女鬼驅逐。於是二人馬上拜他為師。友人意外地被日本忍者所殺，魯興決定要學習絕世茅術，與大師一起對付殘暴的忍者，因而引發終極亂鬥！.

programme.title: 老夫子奇趣錄 / Mr. Funnybone Strikes Again
programme.desc: 電影承上集繼續笑料百出。這次，大蕃薯開了一家中醫診所，但傳統的中醫似乎不為時髦的香港社會接受。最後得靠好友老夫子相助，為他解決疑難！.

programme.title: 水滸傳 / The Water Margin
programme.desc: 此片是張徹導演的史詩式武俠鉅作。宋朝官府被貪官污吏和土豪劣紳控制，於是宋江帶領一百零八位英雄義士齊集梁山。這羣實力非凡的英雄好漢，形成了一股強大的武裝勢力，一場梁山好漢與官府的大戰就此展開。.

programme.title: 玉堂春 / The Story of Sue San
programme.desc: 王金龍與名妓蘇三相愛，無奈無錢被趕出富春院。蘇被老鴇賣予富戶沈燕林為妾，卻被沈妻誣告毒殺親夫，判以死罪。已考取功名的王，決意開堂覆審救蘇...

programme.title: 惡爺 / The Bully
programme.desc: 故事講述，惡少洪毛九不時到蘇記飯店滋事搗蛋，蘇老闆欺善怕惡，把滿腔氣憤發洩在夥記阿七身上。後阿七發覺小廚師張彪武功不凡，遂暗中模仿其動作練武；一日洪毛九又來飯店滋擾，阿七施展出所練功夫打得洪毛九狼狽而逃….

programme.title: 倩女幽魂 / Enchanting Shadow
programme.desc: 年輕書生寧采臣在傳說鬧鬼的恐怖寺廟裡過夜。雖然他不相信傳聞，卻遇上美麗的女鬼聶小倩。原來聶小倩被困在寺廟中，誘使年輕男子給魔頭姥姥享用。寧采臣得悉聶小倩為一隻善良的女鬼，於是決定助她逃離魔掌。.

programme.title: 女殺手 / The Lady Professional
programme.desc: 女殺手被組織控制，強逼去殺商界名人石英，險中殺人滅口的陷阱。她不想淪為殺人工具，決心進行報仇大計，故事曲折離奇...

programme.title: 後門 / Rear Entrance
programme.desc: 本片由著名文學家徐籲的小說《後門》改編，故事講述徐天鶴與太太結婚多年，膝下猶虛，對隔壁小女孩阿琳甚有好感。阿琳父母離婚，孤苦伶仃，徐太太提議收阿琳為繼女，琳父母喜不自勝。後來阿琳親母史小姐出現，要接回阿琳；徐太太不忍拆散母女骨肉，毅然將阿琳交回親母。.

programme.title: 洪熙官 / Executioners From Shaolin
programme.desc: 清廷走狗白眉道人焚毀少林寺後，繼續追捕殘存的少林弟子。洪熙官在逃亡期間遇見了方詠春，兩人墜入愛河結為夫婦，並育有一子名為文定。洪熙官最終被白眉所殺，文定決心融合父母遺留下的武藝，創立虎鶴雙形拳，以報父仇。.

programme.title: 乾隆下揚州 / The Voyage of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: 乾隆皇繼續微服南巡，這次得大臣和大學士陪行，他們一行三人來到揚州，期間遇上不少趣事。.

programme.title: 死囚 / The Condemned
programme.desc: 流浪漢馮大剛被誤指為劫匪，遭逮捕後關押於死囚牢。真正的劫匪為了滅口，賄賂獄中扒手楊靈對馮大剛下毒手。楊靈明白馮大剛是冤枉的，於是暗中設法幫助他逃獄。誰料逃獄計劃意外失敗，最終兩人反而成為真正的死囚。.

programme.title: 死囚 / The Condemned
programme.desc: 流浪漢馮大剛被誤指為劫匪，遭逮捕後關押於死囚牢。真正的劫匪為了滅口，賄賂獄中扒手楊靈對馮大剛下毒手。楊靈明白馮大剛是冤枉的，於是暗中設法幫助他逃獄。誰料逃獄計劃意外失敗，最終兩人反而成為真正的死囚。.

programme.title: 鱷魚河 / Crocodile River
programme.desc: 這個故事洋溢著《羅密歐與茱麗葉》般的悲戀色彩。兩個世代積怨已深的家族，被一條遍佈鱷魚的河流阻隔，誰也不願築橋往來。然而，命運卻讓兩家子女在大學裡邂逅並深深相愛。為了相守，他們不僅必須跨越險惡的河流，更要化解兩個家族間延續多年的仇恨。.

programme.title: 水晶人 / Portrait In Crystal
programme.desc: 故事講述，龍飛精心雕琢的水晶美人像忽然失蹤後，多名黑道高手離奇被殺，江湖傳言乃水晶人變成精靈殺人之所為。龍飛經過連番追蹤後，終發現水晶人乃日後訓練之殺手。水晶人揭發江湖廝殺之真正幕後人，實為偽裝王爺的天帝...

programme.title: 夜生活的女人 / Woman of the Night
programme.desc: 本片由三個內容不同的故事構成。青年喜歡偷窺異性，結果其姐懇求雇主交際花實行肉身布施，驚醒青年迷夢。好色總經理常設計欲打美貌秘書的主意，偷香不到，反被懲戒。好丈夫喪失性能力，不願妻子痛苦，故作暴躁舉動，讓其妻帶著女兒離去，十年後，一家才得以諒解。.

programme.title: 追魂鏢 / Killer Darts
programme.desc: 故事描述青虹大俠劉文龍的徒弟鬍子峰不耐孤寂生活，非禮殺害村婦後逃走。劉收婦遺孤玉蟬為徒，玉蟬長大後與劉子玉郎相愛，但玉蟬偶遇胡，誤信劉是殺母仇人….

programme.title: 警察 / Police Force
programme.desc: 梁觀偕同情侶沈燕，在郊外遊玩談心時，不幸遇上歹徒劫財色，梁護花不成更慘遭毒手。梁之摯友黃國棟報仇心切，遂毅然投身警界，期有機會親自偵緝兇手。五年後，黃因出眾表現被升職之餘，亦與沈日久生情；不久，因一宗離奇的謀殺案件，沈認出當年殺害梁的兇手…….

programme.title: 我們戀愛去了 / Let's Fall In Love
programme.desc: 一次偶然機會下，富家子大用巧遇育幼院院長之外甥女連蓮。二人初次見面，雙方即發生誤會，大用更在匆忙間遺下皮包。當大用硬將連蓮假裝成爲自己的未婚妻好讓兩個傾慕他的女子死心時，又與連蓮發生了第二次誤會...

programme.title: 大旗英雄傳 / Clan Feuds
programme.desc: 鐵中棠是大旗門掌門人雲翼的義子。門派宿敵司徒笑為奪取秘藏，追殺鐵中棠與雲翼次子雲錚。鐵中棠得知，唯有前往長春島尋找武功蓋世的「日后」，才能揭開大旗門的秘密。然而抵達後卻發現「日后」早已身亡，反而遇見大旗門創始人「夜帝」鐵毅，並驚覺對方竟是自己的親生父親。.

programme.title: 扭計祖宗陳夢吉 / Two Con Men
programme.desc: 華南影帝張瑛與梁天合作的清末喜劇，二人分飾師爺荒唐鏡及奇人陳夢吉。陳得知荒平素極盡斂財害人之能事，遂喬扮應徵僕人...

programme.title: 卒仔抽車 / Rolls, Rolls, I Love You
programme.desc: 阿旦、墨魚、阿喜、荷官等一群窮小子，遇上生活寂寥的富豪崔東成，達成了一個賭局，要於十日內偷得崔的名車。五人與崔鬥智鬥力，終戰勝億萬富豪！.

programme.title: 阿牛出獄記 / Return of the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: 續集中阿牛不幸的遭遇更令人心痛，當中不少更是笑中有淚的經歷。阿牛出獄後，再遇愛人阿花，可惜她已嫁為人妻；另一方面，戇直的阿牛仍不斷被狡猾的周大叔欺騙...

programme.title: 大刀王五 / Iron Bodyguard
programme.desc: 經營鏢局的大刀王五遇上譚嗣同，這位新黨成員致力於改革清末政府。雖然皇帝支持推行新法，但慈禧太后卻無意交出政權，因此她下令捉拿新黨的所有成員。儘管王五並無政治立場，卻無奈地被捲入這場政治漩渦之中。.

programme.title: 我愛金龜婿 / We Love Millionaires
programme.desc: 三個香港美少女何莉莉、陳依齡及淩雲，帶著愛情夢遠赴日本大阪，一心指望釣得如意郎君。豈料三人被誤會是富家千金，結果惹出趣事連篇。.

programme.title: 金臂童 / The Kid with the Golden Arm
programme.desc: 虎威鏢局總鏢頭楊虎雲受官府之託，押运二十萬兩黃金赴黃河流域賬災，武林豪傑「長斧」殷九、「短斧」方十、「冷月劍」冷鳳、「寒星劍」李青冥等紛紛前來助陣。當時「七殺谷」中一批武功高強的劇盜，早就佈署截劫詭計，鏢隊幸得「千面神捕」海濤沿途暗中出手相助，化險為夷...

programme.title: Kalung Bisa Dicari Tapi Yang Tulus Tak Datang Dua Kali
programme.desc: Naura sangat membutuhkan pekerjaan untuk memenuhi kebutuhan hidupnya sehari-hari. Semua perusahaan yang membuka lowongan pekerjaan selalu menolaknya karena penampilannya yang dinilai tidak menarik karena wajahnya berjerawat. Pada suatu hari, si gadis bertemu dengan seorang pria bernama Zidan yang menanyakan penyebab wajah si gadis seperti itu. Zidan menyarankan agar wanita muda tersebut pergi ke dokter agar kulitnya menjadi mulus kembali. Setelah itu ia pergi. Selanjutnya, saat terjadi sedang menunggu kendaraan umum di sebuah halte, dia bertemu dengan seorang bapak tua yang membutuhkan pertolongan. Sang gadis pun memberikan pertolongan kepada si bapak yang membutuhkan uang. Lalu, tiba-tiba si bapak memberikan gadis tersebut sebuah kalung.

programme.title: Masuk Kuping Kiri Keluar Beli Keripik
programme.desc: Nando dan Tara bersaing untuk berjualan keripik yang paling laris. Nando dan Tara selalu berselisih setiap kali bertemu. Namun siapa sangka? Dari pertemuan tersebut lama-lama mereka saling jatuh cinta.

programme.title: Bidadari Surgamu
programme.desc: Menceritakan kisah seorang gadis bernama Sakinah yang menjalani hidup penuh tekanan karena fitnah dan dipaksa menikah dengan orang yang tidak mencintainya. Tidak hanya itu, Sakinah bahkan dihalangi untuk tau siapa Ibu kandung yang tega membuangnya. Bagaimana kelanjutan kisah hidup Sakinah?

programme.title: Cinta Dua Pilihan
programme.desc: Fathir dan Sukma adalah sepasang suami istri yang hidup sederhana namun bahagia. Sampai akhirnya sang buah hati Zahra divonis menderita sakit yang serius ditengah keluarga mereka yang masih serba kekurangan. Disaat bersamaan, Fathir tidak sengaja bertemu dengan mantannya Clara. Kehadiran Clara mengubah segalanya.

programme.title: Kalung Bisa Dicari Tapi Yang Tulus Tak Datang Dua Kali
programme.desc: Naura sangat membutuhkan pekerjaan untuk memenuhi kebutuhan hidupnya sehari-hari. Semua perusahaan yang membuka lowongan pekerjaan selalu menolaknya karena penampilannya yang dinilai tidak menarik karena wajahnya berjerawat. Pada suatu hari, si gadis bertemu dengan seorang pria bernama Zidan yang menanyakan penyebab wajah si gadis seperti itu. Zidan menyarankan agar wanita muda tersebut pergi ke dokter agar kulitnya menjadi mulus kembali. Setelah itu ia pergi. Selanjutnya, saat terjadi sedang menunggu kendaraan umum di sebuah halte, dia bertemu dengan seorang bapak tua yang membutuhkan pertolongan. Sang gadis pun memberikan pertolongan kepada si bapak yang membutuhkan uang. Lalu, tiba-tiba si bapak memberikan gadis tersebut sebuah kalung.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Hati Yang Memilih (Rr)
programme.desc: Perjuangan Putri (Amanda Manopo), seorang gadis penjual buah yang melarikan diri demi menghindari perjodohan paksa oleh ibu tirinya yang materialistis. Dalam pelariannya, Putri bertemu dengan Dewa (Adly Fairuz) yang menjadi pelindung sekaligus tambatan hatinya. Namun, perjalanan cinta dan hidup mereka dipenuhi cobaan berat karena hadirnya konflik keluarga, rahasia masa lalu, serta intrik cinta segitiga dengan pria lain seperti Mike dan Raja yang menguji keteguhan hati Putri untuk memilih cinta sejatinya.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Pagi : Preman Pensiun Deui
programme.desc: Pensiunnya Bahar (pemimpin preman) dan kekacauan yang terjadi di wilayah kekuasaannya setelah ia menyerahkan urusan pada tangan kanannya, Muslihat, yang kemudian mencoba mengambil alih, memicu konflik dengan anak buah seperti Jamal dan Komar, memaksa Bahar turun tangan lagi untuk menyelesaikan masalah dan mengembalikan ketertiban, seperti kasus tanah di kampung dan penahanan Jamal.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Pagi : Terlanjur Mencintaimu Arumi (Rr)
programme.desc: Arumi, seorang barista keliling pekerja keras, menikah dengan Rendi, namun kemudian mengetahui bahwa pria itu sudah beristri dan hanya memanfaatkannya demi mendapatkan pewaris. Sempat mengira bayinya telah meninggal, ia akhirnya mengungkap kebenaran dan menemukan harapan baru bersama Elio.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Pagi : Mencintaimu Sekali Lagi Arini (Rr)
programme.desc: Arini, seorang penata rias sukses yang digemari para selebritas papan atas, mengalami patah hati saat memergoki kekasihnya berselingkuh dengan sahabatnya sendiri. Sempat kehilangan kepercayaan pada cinta, ia bertemu dengan Lingga yang perlahan memikat hatinya. Namun, masalah muncul ketika Emil, saudara laki-laki Lingga, juga jatuh hati padanya.

programme.title: Go Spot Eksklusif
programme.desc: Program yang menayangkan Film dari berbagai genre seperti romansa dan komedi yang seru dan menghibur untuk disaksikan selama moment liburan.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia - Terikat Janji Selamanya
programme.desc: Davina Rosalia Kusuma, putri pengusaha, tampak hidup sempurna namun menyimpan luka sejak ibunya meninggal dan ayahnya menikah lagi. Ia merasa terasing, terlebih setelah cinta pertamanya, Ryan, menghilang. Sepuluh tahun kemudian, pertunangannya dengan Dipa hancur karena perselingkuhan dengan adik tirinya, Jihan. Di tengah keterpurukan, Davina bertemu Sena, penjual ketoprak yang ternyata polisi intel yang menyelidiki Dipa. Davina meminta Sena berpura-pura menjadi pacarnya, namun hubungan palsu itu berubah menjadi nyata. Tanpa ia tahu, Sena juga mencari kebenaran tentang hilangnya Ryanmembawa mereka pada rahasia, balas dendam, dan perasaan yang tak terduga.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia - Ikatan Cinta Aldebaran & Andin
programme.desc: Mengisahkan dua saudara perempuan bernama Andien dan Elsa. Keduanya tidak menyadari bahwa mereka sama-sama mencintai pria yang sama, yaitu Nino. Hubungan yang sudah renggang di antara mereka semakin memburuk setelah Elsa mengetahui bahwa Nino berencana menikahi Andien. Setelah menikah, Elsa memfitnah Andien hingga diceraikan Nino. Ditengah luka tersebut Andien bertemu dengan Aldebaran yang sengaja mendekati Andien untuk membalas dendam adiknya. Namun dengan kebaikan hati Andien, perlahan Aldebaran melihat kebenaran dan mulai jatuh cinta pada Andien

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Ternyata Ini Cinta
programme.desc: Setelah sebuah kecelakaan merenggut nyawa ayahnya, Luna kembali ke dunia balap liar. Persaingannya dengan Marco berubah menjadi kisah cinta, hingga rahasia mengenai status anak angkatnya dan geng Spider mengungkap kebenaran di balik kematian sang ayah.

programme.title: Microdrama + : Culun Tapi Sultan
programme.desc: Vincent, mahasiswa polos yang sering diremehkan, jatuh cinta pada Elena, wanita yang diam-diam hanya mengincar kekayaan keluarganya. Demi cinta, Vincent menuruti semua keinginannya, hingga sahabatnya, Dea, membuka mata Vincent tentang pengkhianatan itu. Saat kebenaran terungkap, cinta berubah menjadi ancaman, dan nyawa Vincent dipertaruhkan.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia - Terikat Janji Selamanya
programme.desc: Davina Rosalia Kusuma, putri pengusaha, tampak hidup sempurna namun menyimpan luka sejak ibunya meninggal dan ayahnya menikah lagi. Ia merasa terasing, terlebih setelah cinta pertamanya, Ryan, menghilang. Sepuluh tahun kemudian, pertunangannya dengan Dipa hancur karena perselingkuhan dengan adik tirinya, Jihan. Di tengah keterpurukan, Davina bertemu Sena, penjual ketoprak yang ternyata polisi intel yang menyelidiki Dipa. Davina meminta Sena berpura-pura menjadi pacarnya, namun hubungan palsu itu berubah menjadi nyata. Tanpa ia tahu, Sena juga mencari kebenaran tentang hilangnya Ryanmembawa mereka pada rahasia, balas dendam, dan perasaan yang tak terduga.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia - Ikatan Cinta Aldebaran & Andin
programme.desc: Mengisahkan dua saudara perempuan bernama Andien dan Elsa. Keduanya tidak menyadari bahwa mereka sama-sama mencintai pria yang sama, yaitu Nino. Hubungan yang sudah renggang di antara mereka semakin memburuk setelah Elsa mengetahui bahwa Nino berencana menikahi Andien. Setelah menikah, Elsa memfitnah Andien hingga diceraikan Nino. Ditengah luka tersebut Andien bertemu dengan Aldebaran yang sengaja mendekati Andien untuk membalas dendam adiknya. Namun dengan kebaikan hati Andien, perlahan Aldebaran melihat kebenaran dan mulai jatuh cinta pada Andien

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: The film's story unfolds in the fictional country of Laika and in Hong Kong, China. A police academy student who has not yet graduated, Ashan (played by Gu Bin), is tasked with a dangerous mission. He helps the criminal organization by eliminating obstacles for their leader, Atian (played by An Zhi Jie), in prison. Ashan approaches Atian, gains his trust, and collects evidence against the criminal group. After both of them are released from prison, Ashan assists Atian in rising within the criminal organization in Hong Kong. After enduring numerous challenges, Atian successfully replaces the group's leader, Bao Ge (played by Zeng Zhiwei), becoming the new boss and taking control of the organization. However, just as Ashan is about to complete his mission, his true identity is exposed.

programme.title: Putri Pewaris

programme.title: Cinta Seluas Samudra

Saat Maya ternyata masih hidup dan berada di tangan Roni, sebuah konspirasi membuatnya percaya bahwa Andrian telah mengkhianatinya.

In the skies above, Grandmaster Glitch tries to fix his Grimbot when a loose spring causes it to bounce about inside Grim HQ like a children's toy. It accidentally gets a blast from Glitch's size ray and grows to gigantic proportions. Another Grimbot pulls a lever and the monster robot slips through the front hatch, tumbling towards the ruins below., G, rerun

Two best friends grow up together and teasingly meet two delightfully impish boys leading to the four to flirtatiously intermingle. However, the innocence of partner swapping eventually leads to a roller-coaster bouts of misunderstood emotions., PG, rerun

programme.title: Five Elements Ninjas
programme.desc: After a Japanese samurai is defeated and commits seppuku, ninja lord Chin leads his clan to China for revenge. They challenge martial arts leader Yuan with the deadly Five Elements Ninja Formation, wiping out his unprepared disciples. The survivors must master the enemy's techniques to break the formation and avenge their comrades., NC16, rerun

programme.title: Return Of The Dead
programme.desc: A long-awaited horror sequel after Enchanted Shadow, this is about three asylum inmates telling their stories. In story one, a husband and wife discover they should be careful what they wish for. A naked female ghost seeks revenge from her watery grave in story two, and a dead prostitute returns as a ghost in the last tale., M18, rerun

programme.title: Five Tough Guys
programme.desc: A titular gang of misfits come together to protect a patriotic general from a scheming usurper. To this end, the unlikely heroes act as the general's escorts on a dangerous journey to a distant British consulate, beset by enemies and sinister Japanese interference along the way., PG, rerun

programme.title: Black Magic
programme.desc: Hsu Lo is up against an evil black magic practitioner San Kan Mi, who wants to place a death spell on him and a love spell on his fiancee Wang Chu Ying. Fortunately, Wang's friends manage to find another veteran witch doctor to take on the evil San. This bone-chilling tale of good versus evil races to a heart-stopping ending., NC16, rerun

programme.title: Crazy Nuts Of Kung Fu
programme.desc: A roadside bandit and a traveling gambler team up to make money from gambling. In a successful attempt to steal a huge amount of money from a warlord's home, they encounter revolutionists who seek their help to fund the reform campaign. Will the two help the revolutionists' cause with the stolen money?, NC16, rerun

programme.title: The Eunuch
programme.desc: A year before Lo Wei directed Bruce Lee in Fist Of Fury, he wrote and co-starred in this tale of a treacherous devil who wants nothing less than supreme power...and doesn't care if he has to murder the Emperor and use his own daughter as a deadly dupe to get it., NC16, rerun

programme.title: The Deadly Breaking Sword
programme.desc: Warrior Tuan Chang Qing meets courtesan Liu Yin Xi in a small town. Liu pleads Tuan to kill the underworld master Guo Tian Sheng, known as the Killer Doctor, in order to avenge the death of her fiance. Tuan and gambling addict Xiao Dao breaks into Guo's household, triggering the battle of good against evil., PG, rerun

programme.title: The Female Prince
programme.desc: Hsiao's stepmother frames her fiance Lung when he refuses to forfeit their engagement and sends him to prison. To save him, Hsiao disguises as Lung to take the Imperial exam and ranks first place. Impressed by Hsiao, the Emperor weds the Princess to 'him'. When Hsiao comes clean on their wedding night, she persuades the Princess to follow a plan..., G, rerun

programme.title: The Singing Thief
programme.desc: A master jewel thief turns over a new leaf as a professional singer in a nightclub. However, a series of robberies happened shortly after and he becomes the suspect again. The thief then sets up a trap to snare the copycat but will this backfire on him?, PG13, rerun

programme.title: The Tiger and the Widow
programme.desc: The Liu Chia-liang trained Hui Ying-hung was considered the top action martial arts female star in the 1980s. It is her martial arts abilities that Michelle Yeoh tries to emulate. In The Tiger and the Widow, Hui Ying-hung is somehow mixed up in a salt smuggling ring that stinks of missing persons and rotten dilemmas., PG13, rerun

programme.title: Six Assassins
programme.desc: Lord Li Ming is a feudal tyrant who oppresses the people, and even the Emperor who is his brother, cannot stop his evil act. Righteous swordsman Mu poses as Li Ming's guard to plan for his assassination. He arrests six assassins who have tried to kill Li Ming, before making them his allies in a secret plot to kill him and end the tyranny., PG13, rerun

programme.title: A Maid From Heaven
programme.desc: The seventh daughter of the Jade Emperor is banished from heaven to live a mortal life as she is very mischievous. She falls in love with a young village lad Yong, who sold himself to work for the rich so as to bury his father. The goddess sisters help Yong to pay his debt so the lovebirds can be together. Is this going to end happily-ever-after?, G, rerun

programme.title: Dragon Swamp
programme.desc: Fan is cheated by her lover Tong to steal her master's Jade Dragon Sword. She is jailed in the Dragon Swamp as punishment and gave birth to a pair of twins - her daughter is raised by her master, while her son is taken by Tong. Twenty years later, the sword is stolen again and Fan's daughter goes seeking for it, meeting Fan's friend along the way., PG13, rerun

programme.title: Sunset
programme.desc: Teenage heart-throbs Ching Li and Paul Chin Pei come across like Annette Funicello and Frankie Avalon in the musical Sunset, a musical romp that plays similar to one of Hollywood's famous Beach Party movies. A car load of girls meets a car load of boys, and Ching and Paul ultimately fall in love. Yet the film takes an acrid twist and turns out to be more like a Shakespearian tragedy than a beach-babe party., PG, rerun

programme.title: The Flying Dagger
programme.desc: The Yu family and the Green Dragon clan became enemies when the Yu daughter killed the clan head's son, who was a rapist and murderer. The Green Dragon leader wounds the head of the Yu family with his flying daggers, and a wandering swordsman saves the family using his own flying dagger skills. However, his allegiances and motives are unclear., NC16, rerun

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants., PG13, rerun

programme.title: Mr Vampire Saga 4
programme.desc: A Buddhist monk and Taoist priest put aside their differences to take on vampires that have been struck by lightning and have now become a super powered threat to mankind., NC16, rerun

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Neng was a street fighter in Northeast China but decides to start a new life in Hong Kong’s Kowloon Walled City. Unfortunately, he is implicated in the fights and conspiracies among the triad forces. When his good friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must team up with the residents of Kowloon Walled City to fight back and save his friend., NC16, rerun

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its “Cop Shop Babes” as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat – can they resolve the case?, PG13, rerun

programme.title: Open the Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case., NC16, rerun

programme.title: Legend Of The Fist- The Return Of Chen Zhen
programme.desc: In 1920s Shanghai, Chen Zhen goes undercover as a businessman to expose a mob boss's collaboration with the Japanese. While gaining his trust, he must also combat a wave of assassins sent by a brutal Japanese general. Fighting from the shadows in a black mask, he allies with a police captain to protect the city's patriots with his formidable fists., NC16, rerun

programme.title: Let The Bullets Fly
programme.desc: Bandit Zhang Mu Zhi poses as a county chief and arrives in Goose Town hoping to make a fortune, only to encounter the ruthless and manipulative tycoon Huang Si Lang, who controls the town with fear and corruption. As the two powerful men clash, a thrilling battle of wits, deception, greed and gunfire erupts, throwing the entire town into chaos., NC16, rerun

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: The infamous “Gang Trio” is hired to kidnap a baby for 30 million. When they discover the triad intends to seize the ransom and kill the child, they take the baby under their wing. Cornered by cops and hunted by gangsters, the three “Rob-B-Hood” must put the baby safely back in his cradle., PG, rerun

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love., NC16, rerun

programme.title: Final Justice (1988)
programme.desc: Chang is a brilliant police inspector, but his maverick ways have put him at odds with both his superiors and peers. When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice., NC16, rerun

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A spicy hot pot restaurant in Northeast China serves different types of customers every day. Amongst them are a sweet young couple, two wayward young men and a taxi driver. Despite being complete strangers to each other, their lives are intertwined by a traffic accident…, PG13, rerun

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: A special agent from the Japanese National Security teams up with a skilled thief to find a pair of plates used to make counterfeit USD. However, a US Embassy representative appears and steals the plates, running away to Korea with them., NC16, rerun

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?, NC16, rerun

programme.title: Kung Fu Jungle
programme.desc: Jailed for accidental manslaughter, martial arts master Har Hao Mo discovers a killer targeting kung fu masters across Hong Kong. Determined to stop the murders, he helps police track down Fung Yu Sau, a ruthless fighter obsessed with proving his supremacy. As the killings continue, the two martial artists are drawn toward a deadly showdown., NC16, rerun

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made., M18, rerun

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad., NC16, rerun

programme.title: The Sorcerer And The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural., NC16, rerun

programme.title: Shaolin
programme.desc: After betrayal by his trusted deputy and the death of his daughter, ruthless warlord Hau Kit loses everything and seeks refuge at Shaolin Temple. There, he begins a journey toward redemption. However, when his former deputy Cho Man leads troops to destroy the city, Hau Kit must rise again to protect Shaolin and atone for his past sins., NC16, rerun

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: This is a remake of the original 1966 classic, Dragon Gate Inn. The country is being policed by the East and West Bureaus, whilst the Emperor’s eunuchs have attained much power and control. With all the corruption, Zhao teams up with a group of assassins to systemically kill the eunuchs in order to save the country., NC16, rerun

programme.title: Green Wood Robbery
programme.desc: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter —the sole witness— mysteriously disappears. For decades, the haunting of the Kang house on Green Wood Lane lingers. As the truth behind the tragedy unfolds, motives of revenge and death intertwine in this chilling mystery., PG13, rerun

programme.title: The Myth

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!

programme.desc: 3 couples falls in love with each other in 3 different love stories.

programme.desc: Kisah pengembaraan Puyah, seorang gadis kampung becok yang disukai ramai, apabila dia melawat Kuala Lumpur dan termasuk set filem secara tak sengaja, dan tak semena-mena mula mendapat nama sebagai pelakon.

programme.title: Ting Tong, Love
programme.desc: Bored by his mother's insistence on his getting married, Hairi finally agrees on the condition that he could choose his own soul mate. Does the choice of Hairi meet with his mother's approval?

programme.title: Chomel
programme.desc: After her mother's death, Mimi's family fell apart. One day, Mimi finds Chomel, a cat and brings it home, only for it to cause a series of events that brings her broken family back together again.

programme.title: My Future Husband
programme.desc: Emily berharap untuk menemui bakal suami dan pada suatu hari muncul seorang lelaki bernama Atta yang mengaku dia adalah suami Emily dari masa hadapan.

programme.title: Mat So'od

programme.title: Kipas Belum Mati
programme.desc: Mia, seorang artis meningkat naik, membuka kelab peminatnya dan dibantu oleh Lynn yang menjadi pengurus. Dengan bantuan Lynn, kelabnya maju namun ada harga yang harus dibayar di sebalik kejayaan tersebut..

programme.title: Geng
programme.desc: Isabella is an ex-convict who has sworn off her life of crime. Unfortunately, her old gang boss wants her to do one last drug transaction and kidnaps her mother to blackmail Isabella. With the help of her high school best friends, Mariam and Anita, Isabella goes on a road trip to save her mother.

programme.title: Keabadian Cinta
programme.desc: 3 couples falls in love with each other in 3 different love stories.

programme.title: Boyfriend Aku Dari ...

programme.title: Gengster Leng Chai
programme.desc: Black is a failure of a gangster, being too soft hearted with people. After meeting Mawar, he is determined to change despite the objections of others.

programme.title: Strawberi Karipap Sesat Kat Paris
programme.desc: Nini and Haikal start their big adventure to find their aunty Lisa who gets a job offer as a professional photographer in Paris. Unfortunately, their journey turns upside down when they arrive in Paris and ruin a newly-wed coupleís honeymoon.

programme.desc: An angel (Nicolas Cage) considers becoming human after falling in love with a Los Angeles heart surgeon (Meg Ryan). Starring Nicolas Cage, Meg Ryan, Andre Braugher.

programme.desc: On a mission in a Central American jungle, a team of commandos headed by Major Dutch Schaefer find themselves hunted by a fierce extra-terrestrial warrior. Starring Arnold Schwarzenegger, Carl Weathers, Jesse Ventura.

programme.title: Predators
programme.desc: In this new chapter in the Predator universe, a group of cold-blooded killers are brought together on an alien planet to be hunted by a new breed of alien Predators. Starring Adrien Brody, Topher Grace, Alice Braga.

programme.title: The Colony
programme.desc: Forced to live underground, survivors of an ice age embark on a mission to reach another outpost. Starring Laurence Fishburne, Kevin Zegers, Bill Paxton.

programme.title: Dangerous
programme.desc: An ex-con and reformed sociopath battles a band of heavily armed mercenaries as he tries to uncover the truth behind his brother's mysterious death. Starring Scott Eastwood, Mel Gibson, Tyrese Gibson.

programme.title: Passchendaele
programme.desc: Sgt. Dunne returns to war to look after a nurse's brother. Starring Caroline Dhavernas, Gil Bellows, Paul Gross.

programme.title: Upside Down
programme.desc: Though it is forbidden, a man devises a way to reunite with a long-lost love from the twin world that sits just above his own. Starring Kirsten Dunst, Jim Sturgess, Timothy Spall.

programme.title: Snowtime!
programme.desc: Children (Angela Gallupo, Lucinda Davis, Sonja Ball) in a small village learn valuable life lessons when they form two teams for a massive snowball fight. Starring Angela Galuppo, Lucinda Davis, Sonja Ball.

programme.title: Ladies and Gentlemen ... Mr. Leonard Cohen
